CVE-2026-129063.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Brainstorm Force Spectra ultimate-addons-for-gutenberg allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Spectra: from n/a through 2.20.5.

CVE-2026-129995.description: mcp-ssh-manager is an MCP server for managing servers over SSH with human approval, an encrypted vault, and a live audit trail. Prior to 3.8.5, ssh_backup_create, ssh_backup_restore, ssh_backup_schedule, and ssh_backup_list build remote shell commands from caller-controlled values in src/backup-manager.js and inline backup handlers in src/index.js without neutralizing shell metacharacters. Crafted database, connection, backup directory, path, exclusion, schedule, or comment arguments can therefore execute arbitrary OS commands on managed remote servers as the configured SSH user. ssh_backup_schedule can persist execution through cron. ssh_backup_list does not pass through the server policy check and remains available in readonly and restricted modes, allowing command execution despite those restrictions. Tool arguments can be supplied by a malicious or compromised MCP client or steered through indirect prompt injection; fully trusted benign arguments do not trigger the issue. The earlier database-helper remediation for CVE-2026-77383 applied shell quoting to src/database-manager.js but did not cover these parallel backup builders. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.5.

CVE-2026-130601.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons bdthemes-element-pack-lite allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Element Pack Elementor Addons: from n/a through 10.0.9.

CVE-2026-130602.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BdThemes Prime Slider – Addons For Elementor bdthemes-prime-slider-lite allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Prime Slider – Addons For Elementor: from n/a through 5.1.2.

CVE-2026-130901.description: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory in the file access checks in Amazon awslabs.document-loader-mcp-server 1.0.10 through 1.0.20 might allow a context-dependent actor, via crafted document content processed by an MCP client, to read files outside the intended base directory and, in 1.0.12 through 1.0.20, to write PNG slide images outside it. This occurs when DOCUMENT_BASE_DIR is not set or is empty and the CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS or PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST environment variable is present. Versions before 1.0.10 do not restrict file access to a base directory. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 1.0.21 or later. Users who cannot upgrade immediately can set DOCUMENT_BASE_DIR to the directory that holds their documents. Do not set it to /, which removes the restriction.

CVE-2026-133949.description: pip prior to v26.2.2 the certifi bundled with pip contains the compromised eMudhra certificates. Upgrading to a secure version of pip should be done either by first upgrading Python to a version that rejects the compromised intermediates (CVE-2026-115557) or use hash pinning with a known-secure version of pip. pip is not vulnerable when using a Python version that rejects the compromised certificates. See the references below for more information.

CVE-2026-48118.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.5.09, the Comment module accepts attacker-controlled base64 content in the status_comment parameter through modules/comment/funcs/main.php; modules/comment/comment.php decodes it with nv_base64_decode() and assigns it to STATUS_COMMENT without output escaping. The required checkss token was derived from the site-wide NV_CACHE_PREFIX rather than NV_CHECK_SESSION, so a token disclosed in public comment markup could be reused across sessions in a crafted URL. An unauthenticated attacker can therefore cause decoded HTML or JavaScript to render in a victim's browser and perform phishing or same-origin actions. This issue is fixed in version 4.5.09.

CVE-2026-49259.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. From the 4.x release line until 4.5.09, a low-privileged authenticated user can store script-breaking content in the first_name and last_name profile fields used to form a comment display name. Both reply links in themes/default/modules/comment/comment.tpl interpolate {COMMENT.post_name} into the inline onclick call to nv_commment_feedback(). HTML numeric references produced by Request::_get_title() are decoded by the browser before JavaScript parsing, so clicking Reply can terminate the string and execute attacker-controlled JavaScript in the visitor's origin, including an administrator's session. This issue is fixed in version 4.5.09.

CVE-2026-54064.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.5.09, a user with news-posting permission can bypass NukeViet\Core\Request::filterAttr() by prefixing an event-handler attribute with an ASCII form-feed character, which PHP trimming preserves but browsers treat as whitespace. NukeViet\Core\Request::unhtmlentities() omitted a decimal HTML entity tab embedded in a javascript: URI. These parser differences allow persistent event handlers or script URLs to survive filtering in vendor/vinades/nukeviet/Core/Request.php and execute for visitors, including administrators. This issue is fixed in version 4.5.09.

CVE-2026-54065.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.5.09, an authenticated administrator can submit a crafted attach value to modules/comment/admin/edit.php. The handler removed a fixed-length upload prefix without validating containment, allowing padding followed by a traversal path to be stored in the database. When the comment is deleted, modules/comment/admin/del.php joins the stored path to NV_UPLOADS_REAL_DIR and passes it to nv_deletefile(), whose realpath() check restricts deletion only to NV_ROOTDIR rather than the upload directory, permitting deletion of application files such as config.php and causing an outage. This issue is fixed in version 4.5.09.

CVE-2026-55372.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.5.09, an unauthenticated attacker can submit the __serverInfoUpdate=1 field while controlling X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Proto. NukeViet\Core\Server::standardizeHost() did not validate the forwarded host against my_domains, and a trailing slash could preserve an attacker-selected port that server_info_update() used to construct a cURL request in includes/ini.php before authentication. The blind, HEAD-only request uses a fixed path, but it permits internal host and port discovery and can poison cached server_headers. This issue is fixed in version 4.5.09.

CVE-2026-61832.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.6.00, a network attacker who can alter outbound traffic to the extension store can exploit the HTTP client's disabled sslverify setting to substitute a serialized response. Extension-store handlers pass the response to unserialize() without an allowed_classes restriction, allowing an in-tree GuzzleHttp\Cookie\FileCookieJar gadget to write attacker-controlled content to a chosen path. When a GODADMIN opens or uses the store list, detail, install, or update functions, the substituted response can write a PHP file under the web root and execute code as the web-server user. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.00.

CVE-2026-77323.description: MapServer is a system for developing web-based GIS applications. Prior to 8.6.5, an unauthenticated reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in OGC API Features collection-items HTML output allows crafted offset or limit query parameter values from raw CGI request handling in src/mapogcapi.cpp to reach template.params.offset or template.params.limit. share/ogcapi/templates/html-bootstrap/collection-items.html inserts those values without quoting or escaping into a script element. A victim who follows a crafted request can have the script element terminated by attacker-controlled markup, causing arbitrary JavaScript to execute under the MapServer origin and enabling access to browser-session data, actions as the victim, and content manipulation. This issue is fixed in 8.6.5.

CVE-2026-77324.description: MapServer is a system for developing web-based GIS applications. From 4.4.0 until 8.6.5, an unauthenticated remote attacker can send a WCS GetCoverage XML POST request whose BoundingBox element omits the crs attribute, causing xmlGetProp() in src/mapwcs.cpp to return null. msWCSParseRequest() then calls string functions on the null value before normal WCS exception handling, crashing the CGI or FastCGI worker. The analogous KVP or GET path is not affected because it obtains a count-validated, non-null token. A single request can terminate one worker, and repeated requests can exhaust a fixed worker pool and deny service. This issue is fixed in version 8.6.5.

CVE-2026-77325.description: MapServer is a system for developing web-based GIS applications. From 6.0 until 8.6.5, MapServer's WMS OpenLayers output, selected by FORMAT=application/openlayers or template=openlayers, substitutes a request-derived online-resource value into a single-quoted JavaScript string in src/maptemplate.c. The prior remediation for GHSA-xqj6-vjqr-33vv used msEscapeJSonLikeString() to protect the JavaScript string but did not neutralize angle brackets, so attacker-controlled X-Forwarded-Host or X-Forwarded-Proto values can still terminate the script element at the HTML parser layer. Deployments that expose attacker-controlled PATH_INFO or map= values reaching the same string are also affected. An unauthenticated attacker can cause arbitrary JavaScript to execute in a victim's browser under the MapServer origin when the victim loads the crafted output. This issue is fixed in version 8.6.5.

CVE-2026-77326.description: MapServer is a system for developing web-based GIS applications. From 8.2.0 until 8.6.5, an unauthenticated attacker can send a WMS GetLegendGraphic request with a nonempty BBOX and repeated LAYER parameters to trigger a heap buffer overflow in msWMSDispatch() in src/mapwms.cpp. The handler appends synthesized entries to cgiRequestObj.ParamNames and cgiRequestObj.ParamValues at NumParams without retaining the arrays' capacity or reallocating them, while incrementing NumParams inside the loop. Once the parser's hidden capacity is exhausted, the writes pass the heap allocation boundary. A single request can corrupt heap memory and crash the process; code execution may be possible but was not demonstrated. This issue is fixed in version 8.6.5.

CVE-2026-77327.description: MapServer is a system for developing web-based GIS applications. Prior to 8.6.5, MapServer's MySQL JOIN implementation in src/mapjoin.c copies the source layer attribute selected by JOIN ... FROM into joininfo->target and inserts it into the query built by msMySQLJoinNext() without parameterization or SQL escaping. When MySQL JOIN support is enabled, an attacker who can control that source feature attribute, including through imported shapefile or DBF data or another untrusted spatial source, can inject SQL operators or expressions that change the intended JOIN predicate. This can bypass the intended key comparison and expose unrelated records from the MySQL or MariaDB JOIN table through output templates, query responses, or downstream application logic. This issue is fixed in version 8.6.5.

CVE-2026-77328.description: MapServer is a system for developing web-based GIS applications. Prior to 8.6.5, MapServer's PostgreSQL JOIN implementation in src/mappostgresql.c copies the source layer attribute selected by JOIN FROM into joininfo->from_value and embeds it without parameterization or escaping into a dynamically generated PostgreSQL query executed by PQexec(). When PostgreSQL JOIN support is enabled, an attacker who can control that source feature attribute can inject quote characters and SQL operators that alter the intended WHERE predicate. This second-order injection can cause unintended rows and JOIN attributes to be returned, potentially exposing information from unrelated PostgreSQL records. This issue is fixed in version 8.6.5.

CVE-2026-77346.description: Pozeiden is a MermaidJS renderer written in Zig. Prior to 0.3.0, Pozeiden emits attacker-controlled Mermaid values into SVG attributes or markup without sufficient XML escaping or URL scheme validation, and first-party consumers such as zigmark and policypress embed the generated SVG raw into HTML. The click href syntax can introduce a dangerous URL scheme or break out of an attribute; style, classDef, ::: class assignment, and linkStyle color values can inject fill or stroke markup; color and font-weight values can escape text attributes; %%{init}%% themeVariables can inject global renderer attributes; and quadrant y-axis labels can introduce raw markup. These paths involve src/svg/writer.zig, src/renderers/flowchart.zig, src/renderers/quadrant.zig, and src/root.zig. An attacker who can influence rendered Mermaid source can therefore store script-bearing SVG that executes when another user views the published HTML. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.0.

CVE-2026-77347.description: Pozeiden is a MermaidJS renderer written in Zig. Prior to 0.3.0, src/renderers/c4.zig, src/renderers/class.zig, src/renderers/er.zig, and src/renderers/requirement.zig use fixed row-layout arrays while deriving subsequent loop bounds from an untrusted diagram's actual item count, and src/renderers/state.zig indexes a fixed depth array using user-controlled nesting depth. A valid diagram with at least 193 grid items can make the row count exceed the 64-row storage, while a deeply nested state diagram can exceed the col_count depth storage through the public pozeiden.render() path. Safe CLI and ReleaseSafe builds abort the rendering process, enabling reliable denial of service in applications that render untrusted diagrams. ReleaseSmall WASM builds with safety checks disabled instead perform out-of-bounds stack reads or writes, creating a memory-safety violation. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.0.

CVE-2026-77355.description: isomorphic-git is a pure JavaScript implementation of Git for Node.js and browsers. Prior to 1.38.7, tree-entry validation in src/models/GitTree.js does not reject the Windows NTFS reserved pathname alias .git::$INDEX_ALLOCATION. When clone() or checkout materializes an attacker-controlled tree containing this alias on Windows using an NTFS filesystem, the alias resolves to the active .git directory and permits writes to trusted repository metadata instead of a normal worktree directory. A malicious repository or object stream can therefore poison repository configuration, hooks, refs, attributes, or other gitdir state. Strict hosting that rejects hasDotgit objects can block the crafted tree, and non-NTFS systems do not interpret the pathname as the active gitdir. isomorphic-git performs the gitdir write but does not itself execute the written hook or configuration; a later native Git or compatible-tool action, such as processing a poisoned core.fsmonitor value, can execute configured commands as the victim developer or CI identity. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.7.

CVE-2026-77383.description: mcp-ssh-manager is an MCP server for managing servers over SSH with human approval, an encrypted vault, and a live audit trail. Prior to 3.6.7, ssh_db_list, ssh_db_dump, ssh_db_import, and ssh_db_restore in src/database-manager.js interpolate caller-controlled database, table, collection, file path, user, host, port, and password values into shell-evaluated command strings without neutralization. Shell metacharacters in these arguments therefore execute arbitrary commands on the configured SSH target as the account used by the MCP server. ssh_db_list is classified as read-only and remains available in readonly and restricted server security modes, so this path bypasses the command-execution boundary those modes are intended to enforce. The dump and import builders are blocked in readonly mode but remain vulnerable in the default unrestricted mode. The earlier version 3.6.5 hardening covered only ssh_db_query query text; it did not protect the list, dump, import, or restore builders, or the connection flags used by query builders. This issue is fixed in version 3.6.7.

CVE-2026-86017.description: isomorphic-git is a pure JavaScript implementation of Git for Node.js and browsers. Prior to 1.38.8, git cherry-pick applies tree changes through applyTreeChanges in src/utils/walkerToTreeEntryMap.js without checking whether a leading path component is a symbolic link. If a victim worktree contains a tracked symlink to a location outside the worktree and a cherry-picked tree places a file beneath that path, the write follows the symlink and materializes attacker-controlled blob content at the external destination. This allows arbitrary file writes and can cause data tampering, code injection into interpreted files, privilege escalation, denial of service, or follow-on code execution depending on the selected target path. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.8.

CVE-2026-94561.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. In 4.6.00, an unauthenticated attacker can place the configured domain in X-Forwarded-Host while choosing a different destination in the ordinary Host header. The earlier fix validates only the forwarded value in includes/mainfile.php, while set_ini_file() in includes/ini.php constructs an outbound cURL request from the separately retained NV_SERVER_NAME before the ordinary host is rejected. Redirect following can carry the blind request to an attacker-selected private host, port, and path and invoke internal HTTP endpoints. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.01.

CVE-2026-94562.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.6.01, a super-administrator satisfying the NV_IS_SPADMIN gate can use modules/users/admin/fields.php to store an arbitrary existing PHP function in the func_callback setting for a custom profile field because the callback name is checked only with function_exists() and no allowlist restricts which function may be selected. modules/users/fields.check.php later invokes that function through call_user_func() when the field is validated through registration, profile editing, or administrator editing. Selecting a command-execution function crosses the super-administrator to operating-system boundary and executes commands as the web-server account, while ordinary users can trigger the stored callback after it is configured. Because the remediation validates callbacks only when they are written, upgrading does not remove a malicious callback already stored in the database, which must be cleaned manually. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.01.

CVE-2026-94563.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. From 4.5.00 until 4.6.01, an authenticated settings-module administrator can upload a PKCS#12 S/MIME certificate whose X.509 Subject CN contains path separators and traversal components. The smimeadd handler in admin/settings/smtp.php applies only an at-sign replacement before using the CN in .key, .crt, and .pem paths beneath data/certs. Traversal can select attacker-chosen paths outside data/certs, but writes remain constrained to already-existing writable directories and the permitted extensions. Within that constraint, attacker-controlled PEM data can overwrite certificate assets, including a DKIM private key; when the curl.cainfo PHP directive is empty, the attacker can also replace cacert.pem and undermine outbound TLS verification. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.01.

CVE-2026-94564.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.6.01, an unauthenticated visitor can submit Contact module content containing numeric HTML entities with more than eight leading zeros in a URL-bearing attribute. NukeViet\Core\Request::unhtmlentities() does not decode that form before filterAttr() checks for a javascript: scheme, but browsers decode it when rendering the stored content. With an allowed tag such as the default iframe, the reconstructed script URL executes in the administration origin when staff view the message, permitting session-riding actions while remaining unable to read the HttpOnly session cookie directly. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.01.

CVE-2026-94565.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. From the 3.x release line until 4.6.01, an unauthenticated visitor can submit a Contact module message containing an event-handler attribute prefixed by a slash. NukeViet\Core\Request::filterTags() tokenizes attributes using only ASCII spaces, so it sees /onerror and misses the ^on denylist, while the browser treats the slash as a separator and activates onerror. The message is stored and rendered without output encoding in the administration panel, which lacks a Content Security Policy, allowing same-origin JavaScript execution when an administrator opens the message. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.01.

CVE-2026-94566.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. In 4.6.00, an unauthenticated attacker can rotate X-Forwarded-For because vendor/vinades/nukeviet/Core/Ips.php accepts forwarded client-IP headers without first confirming that REMOTE_ADDR is a trusted proxy. The resulting NV_CLIENT_IP keys the administrator login blocker in includes/core/admin_login.php; changing only the header value bypasses that lockout and permits effectively unlimited password guesses. The same spoofable address is also consumed by the user login blocker in modules/users/funcs/login.php, IP restrictions, bans, flood controls, and security logs, but those additional code-level effects were not dynamically demonstrated. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.01.

CVE-2026-94567.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.5.12 and 4.6.02, an attacker with access to an SVG upload flow can hide a script element in an internal DTD entity. NukeViet\Files\Upload::check_svg_tmpfile() loads the document without entity expansion, leaving a DOMEntityReference, and sanitize_svg_dom() inspects only element nodes, while browsers expand the entity when the stored file is served as image/svg+xml. The SVG path also returned before verify_image() and preserved the original bytes, so the hidden script reached disk unchanged. Guest comment attachments make the upload unauthenticated only when a module's comment feature is open to the All or Guest group and allowattachcomm is enabled; module administrators can also use the file manager, allowing same-origin script execution in an administrator's session. This issue is fixed in versions 4.5.12 and 4.6.02.

CVE-2026-94597.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.5.12 and 4.6.02, an attacker who can reach an image-upload flow can upload a valid image with appended PHP short-tag code and a double-extension filename. NukeViet\Files\Upload::save_file() relied on verify_image(), which missed the <? short-open tag, while filename handling preserved embedded dots, validation inspected only the final extension, and an .htaccess rule blocked PHP extensions only at the end of the URI. On Apache mod_php systems configured with short_open_tag and a PHP extension handler, the stored polyglot can execute as PHP and run operating-system commands as the web-server user; PHP-FPM, nginx, and end-anchored handler configurations are not exposed to the execution step. This issue is fixed in versions 4.5.12 and 4.6.02.

CVE-2026-94598.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. From 4.5.08 until 4.5.12 and 4.6.02, an attacker can place NukeViet's internal {@[, ]@}, [@{, and }@] sanitizer markers in an iframe srcdoc value by encoding square brackets as HTML entities. Recursive NukeViet\Core\Request::filterTags() processing decodes the characters, accepts the forged marker, and later converts it to real markup without normal tag or attribute filtering. Because an unsandboxed srcdoc iframe shares the parent origin and iframe is enabled by default through NV_ALLOWED_HTML_TAGS, stored Contact messages, comments with the editor enabled, or submitted articles can execute JavaScript with the viewer's session. This issue is fixed in versions 4.5.12 and 4.6.02.

CVE-2026-94599.description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. From 4.5.00 until 4.5.13 and 4.6.02, an unauthenticated attacker can place a multiply encoded value in the news module search q parameter. $nv_Request->get_title() decodes and sanitizes the input once, but modules/news/funcs/search.php subsequently applies urldecode() after sanitization. The resulting raw keyword reaches the {KEY} search-input attribute through search_theme() and the no-results element through search_result_theme() in the default and mobile themes, permitting attribute or tag injection and same-origin JavaScript execution when a victim opens the crafted search URL. This issue is fixed in versions 4.5.13 and 4.6.02.

CVE-2026-96805.description: The affected products have an unauthenticated command injection, which may allow an in-range BLE device to gain access to write to the control interface and influence braking with no authentication or pairing.

CVE-2026-114494.description: codebase-memory-mcp provides local code intelligence for developers and AI agents through a persistent graph and MCP tools. Prior to 0.9.0, the Cypher parser accepted an unbounded number of projection items in RETURN and WITH clauses while projection executors indexed fixed 32-element stack arrays using the parsed count. A query_graph query with more than 32 projection items could therefore write beyond those arrays, and a related result-column path could read uninitialized stack slots even when no node matched. Any caller of query_graph, including an agent whose query is influenced by untrusted content, could cause a reliable server crash and potentially compromise process confidentiality and integrity. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

CVE-2026-114495.description: codebase-memory-mcp provides local code intelligence for developers and AI agents through a persistent graph and MCP tools. Prior to 0.9.0, automatic import of a repository's .codebase-memory/ artifact allocated a decompression buffer using the attacker-controlled 64-bit original_size value from artifact.json but truncated that value to int when passing the destination capacity to the Zstandard decompressor. A value with bit 31 set became negative and was sign-extended to a large size_t, allowing the decompressor to write frame content beyond the actual allocation. Indexing a malicious repository containing the crafted artifact could corrupt heap memory with attacker-controlled bytes, causing a reliable crash and potentially code execution. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

CVE-2026-114496.description: codebase-memory-mcp provides local code intelligence for developers and AI agents through a persistent graph and MCP tools. Prior to 0.9.0, the detect_changes tool validated the base_branch argument for shell metacharacters but omitted the leading-dash check before placing the value in the revision position of a git diff command. Git therefore interpreted an option-shaped base_branch value, including --output, as a command option instead of a revision, allowing a caller to create or overwrite a caller-chosen file with Git diff output under the server process's permissions. Arbitrary code execution was not demonstrated. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

CVE-2026-114497.description: codebase-memory-mcp provides local code intelligence for developers and AI agents through a persistent graph and MCP tools. Prior to 0.9.1-rc.1, the optional graph UI's POST /api/process-kill route omitted the indexing-job ownership check on Windows while retaining that check on POSIX systems. A requester able to reach the optional UI could supply an arbitrary process identifier, causing TerminateProcess to stop any process that the server user was permitted to terminate. The flaw affects the Windows-specific process termination path and can cause a high availability impact without disclosing or modifying data. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.1-rc.1.

CVE-2026-114499.description: codebase-memory-mcp provides local code intelligence for developers and AI agents through a persistent graph and MCP tools. Prior to 0.10.0, the indexer's .gitignore matcher implemented * and ** through recursive backtracking without a work bound. A repository containing a pattern with repeated wildcard groups and a long path could make matching work grow exponentially, allowing a single ignore rule to stall discovery indefinitely and, before worker isolation, stall the server. The impact is limited to availability, and the bounded matcher does not claim that every expensive input is eliminated. This issue is fixed in version 0.10.0.

CVE-2026-121714.description: RabbitMQ is a messaging and streaming broker. In the affected revision identified by the advisory, the AMQP 1.0 server_mode parser in deps/amqp10_common/src/amqp10_binary_parser.erl stops at the first body section and preserves the remaining bytes in bare_and_footer without validating message-section order. An authenticated publisher with write permission can place a properties section carrying a forged user-id after the body, causing rabbit_access_control:check_user_id/2 to see no user-id while permissive downstream AMQP 1.0 decoders or AMQP 0-9-1 conversion through classic and quorum queues expose the forged identity. Applications that rely on RabbitMQ-validated user-id metadata can therefore accept attacker-controlled publisher attribution. Strict consumers that reject out-of-order sections are not vulnerable to identity spoofing, and the issue does not bypass broker routing or destination authorization. This issue is fixed in version 4.3.5.

CVE-2026-129174.description: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to access a vulnerable endpoint that returns a list of application users and their permissions in plaintext. Fixed on or around 2026-10-19.

CVE-2026-129175.description: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program allows an unauthenticated user to inject unauthorized SQL commands that allow the attacker to gain root access and complete control over the database. Fixed on or around 2026-10-19.

CVE-2026-129176.description: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program accepts a POST request from an unauthenticated user, with no cookie header, to a specific endpoint allowing for the deletion of specified users. Fixed on or around 2026-10-19.

CVE-2026-129177.description: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program contains a vulnerable endpoint that allows an unauthenticated attacker, without a cookie header, to send a POST request resulting in the creation of a new user. Fixed on or around 2026-10-19.

CVE-2026-129178.description: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program stores local user passwords as unsalted MD5 hashes. Fixed on or around 2026-10-19.

CVE-2026-129179.description: U.S Department of the Interior Unstable Slope Management Program allows attackers with valid local application credentials to establish an application session by sending JSON POST requests to the application's login endpoint without a Referrer header or completing the intended Keycloak flow. Fixed on or around 2026-10-19.

CVE-2026-129998.description: MaxKB is an open-source AI assistant for enterprise. Prior to 2.10.7-lts, custom Tool Init Param definitions accept attacker-controlled props_info.rules[].validator strings through POST /admin/api/workspace/{workspace_id}/tool and PUT /admin/api/workspace/{workspace_id}/tool/{tool_id}, store them without restriction, and pass them to eval() when the parameter form renders. An authenticated user with the default USER workspace role can store JavaScript and trigger execution by opening the tool's Debug screen before entering or submitting a parameter value. The same Init Param form is exposed to accounts with edit permission on the tool, but execution by a different account was not independently verified. The confirmed script runs in the MaxKB origin; access to another user's bearer token and authenticated account authority is plausible only if that user renders the malicious form. This issue is fixed in version 2.10.7-lts.

CVE-2026-133680.description: A vulnerability was found in D-Link DCS-935L 1.10.01. This affects the function loginRouter of the file web/cgi-bin/localrecording/setconf.cgi of the component Local Recording CGI. Performing a manipulation of the argument account/password results in os command injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

CVE-2026-133681.description: A vulnerability was determined in Soar Cloud System Human Resources up to 7.3.2026.0112. This impacts an unknown function of the file /client.aspx. CVE-2026-133693.description: A weakness has been identified in continuedev continue 2.0.0/2.1.0. Affected is the function validateSearchAndReplaceFilepath of the file gui/src/util/clientTools/editImpl.ts of the component Edit Tool. Executing a manipulation can lead to path traversal. The attack requires local access. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-134035.description: Krita JC2 File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Krita. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The issue results from the use of a vulnerable version of openjpeg. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-28646.

CVE-2026-134036.description: Krita ABR File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Krita. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of ABR files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-28785.

CVE-2026-134044.description: Open Robotics ROS 2 sros2 load_policy XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of policy XML files. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-32121.

CVE-2026-134045.description: Open Robotics RViz PointCloud2Display PointField Out-of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. CVE-2026-19776.description: G DATA Total Security TSNxGService Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the TSNxGService service. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the service to delete a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-28663.

CVE-2026-19779.description: G DATA Total Security Backup Service Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. The service restores archives from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-28666.

CVE-2026-54023.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. From 0.8.5 until 0.8.6, GET /api/user in api/server/controllers/UserController.js getUserController serializes federatedTokens and tokenset to the authenticated browser because an earlier response-sanitization fix was not applied to this endpoint. Browser-context script can obtain OAuth access, ID, and refresh credentials that were intended to remain server-side. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

CVE-2026-54031.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.8, packages/api/src/mcp/oauth/handler.ts createOAuthFetch validates only the initial destination for MCP OAuth discovery, registration, token, refresh, and revocation requests, then uses redirect-following fetch behavior without validating each redirect target. An attacker who can initiate MCP OAuth against a controlled endpoint can redirect server requests to internal or private addresses, reaching services that the initial SSRF checks should block. The separate MCP transport path already validates redirects and is not affected. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.8.

CVE-2026-54032.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.6, client/src/components/Chat/Input/MCPConfigDialog.tsx renders the remote MCP details.description value through dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitization, allowing a malicious MCP server to execute script when a user opens the configuration dialog. The secondary client/src/components/Banners/Banner.tsx sink similarly renders administrator-controlled banner.message HTML without sanitization for all users. Script execution occurs in the LibreChat browser origin and can expose browser-context data or alter displayed content. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

CVE-2026-54039.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. From 0.7.0 until 0.8.6, when local registration is enabled and at least one social provider is configured, POST /api/auth/register passes an unparsed request object into api/server/services/AuthService.js, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to persist a forged provider value for a known victim email. The api/strategies/socialLogin.js email-fallback path then accepts the planted record when the victim signs in because it compares the stored provider name without requiring the provider subject identifier. The victim OAuth session and the attacker local-password session become bound to the same user record, giving the attacker persistent read and write access to data created by the victim. The first-user administrator role is an additional conditional impact only on a fresh deployment. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

CVE-2026-54041.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.6, the POST /api/auth/login local-login validation path in api/strategies/localStrategy.js logs req.body, including the submitted plaintext password, during a Zod validation failure. The standard browser form validation makes this path less likely through the normal interface, but a direct invalid login request can reach it, and the logging formatter does not redact the password stored in metadata. A principal with access to application stdout, error logs, or journal output can recover the submitted credential. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

CVE-2026-54042.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, POST /api/auth/2fa/verify-temp in api/server/routes/auth.js calls verify2FAWithTempToken and accepts repeated TOTP or backup-code guesses without a dedicated attempt limiter. An attacker must first possess valid primary credentials and a valid five-minute temp token, but can then make repeated second-factor attempts and obtain a full session if a valid code is guessed. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

CVE-2026-54043.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, packages/data-schemas/src/methods/file.ts updateFileUsage accepts chat attachment files[].file_id values without restricting the lookup to the authenticated owner. An authenticated attacker who obtains another user's file identifier, including through GET /api/share/{shareId} for a shared conversation, can attach that file to a chat, causing extracted document text to enter the model context. The same operation can remove expiration metadata from the victim file. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

CVE-2026-54044.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, POST /api/agents/actions/:agent_id in api/server/routes/agents/actions.js loads an existing action with owner credentials and merges editor-controlled metadata.domain and metadata.raw_spec while preserving metadata.api_key and related OAuth client secrets. A collaborator with EDIT permission can repoint an action to an attacker-controlled host, and a later tool invocation decrypts and sends the retained owner credential to that destination. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

CVE-2026-54045.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, POST /api/auth/requestPasswordReset calls deleteTokens by user ID before creating a reset token, while password-reset and email-verification records in packages/data-schemas/src/methods/token.ts have no populated flow type. When password reset is enabled and email verification is enforced, an unauthenticated attacker who knows a target email can repeatedly delete pending verification tokens and prevent account verification until the unverified account expires. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

CVE-2026-54046.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, unauthenticated POST /api/user/verify requests in api/server/routes/user.js call api/server/services/AuthService.js verifyEmail and return distinct responses for unknown, verified, and unverified email addresses and the route lacks request throttling. A remote attacker can submit candidate addresses with invalid tokens to enumerate registered accounts and verification state, supporting targeted phishing or credential attacks. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

CVE-2026-133694.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in continuedev continue 2.0.0/2.1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is the function getSidebarContent of the file extensions/vscode/src/ContinueGUIWebviewViewProvider.ts of the component Mermaid Diagram Renderer. The manipulation leads to os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-133695.description: A vulnerability was detected in continuedev continue 2.0.0/2.1.0. Affected by this issue is the function DocsCrawler of the file core/indexing/docs/crawlers/DocsCrawler.ts of the component Docs Crawler. The manipulation of the argument startUrl/useLocalCrawling results in server-side request forgery. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The attack requires a high level of complexity. The exploitation is known to be difficult. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-133696.description: A flaw has been found in continuedev continue up to 2.1.0. This affects the function DataLogger.logDevData of the file core/data/log.ts of the component Dev Data Logging. This manipulation causes information disclosure. The attack can be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-133697.description: A vulnerability has been found in continuedev continue up to 2.1.0. This vulnerability affects the function LocalPlatformClient.resolveFQSNs of the file core/config/yaml/LocalPlatformClient.ts of the component Config Resolution. Such manipulation of the argument Name leads to information disclosure. Local access is required to approach this attack. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-134126.description: WPC Smart Messages for WooCommerce plugin before 4.3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor or Author privileges to disclose arbitrary post meta and private product data by supplying attacker-controlled id and key attributes to the [wpcsm_product_field] and [wpcsm_product_data] shortcodes without any capability or protected-meta checks. Attackers can embed these shortcodes in a published post to exfiltrate sensitive order data such as billing email, phone, and address stored as post meta, as well as private or draft product descriptions and purchase notes, exposing confidential customer and business information to unauthenticated site visitors.

CVE-2026-54026.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.6, POST /api/messages/:conversationId authorizes req.params.conversationId in api/server/middleware/validateMessageReq.js but persists attacker-controlled req.body.conversationId through api/server/routes/messages.js. An authenticated attacker can use an owned conversation in the URL while naming a victim conversation in the body, causing an attacker-controlled message to be stored in the victim conversation. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

CVE-2026-54038.description: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.9, GET /api/permissions/search-principals passes the q parameter to JavaScript RegExp construction and MongoDB regex queries in packages/data-schemas/src/methods/userGroup.ts findGroupsByNamePattern and searchPrincipals without escaping metacharacters. An authenticated user with people-picker permission can submit a catastrophic-backtracking pattern that blocks the Node.js event loop and makes the service unresponsive to concurrent users; invalid patterns can also produce server errors. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.9.

CVE-2026-133835.description: A flaw has been found in hankcs HanLP up to 2.1.6. Impacted is the function uncompress of the file hanlp/utils/io_util.py of the component TAR Archive Extraction Handler. This manipulation causes path traversal. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.1.7 is recommended to address this issue. Patch name: feb0f82d12762cf4e687b9926efd90c672857780. You should upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-133836.description: A vulnerability has been found in hankcs HanLP up to 2.1.6. The affected element is the function RNNLanguageModel.load_language_model of the file hanlp/layers/embeddings/contextual_string_embedding.py. Such manipulation of the argument model_file leads to deserialization. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.1.7 is sufficient to fix this issue. The name of the patch is 6962907e37dfa467fa6dee164b5b1d0a904b24db. The affected component should be upgraded.

CVE-2026-133937.description: A flaw has been found in highlight highlight.js up to 11.12.0. The affected element is the function hljs.highlight of the file src/languages/livescript.js of the component Language Grammar Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument text can lead to inefficient regular expression complexity. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

CVE-2026-134136.description: OceanWP WordPress Theme before 4.2.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the oceanwp_edd_terms_list() function in inc/edd/edd-helpers.php, which allows authenticated users with EDD download category creation permissions to inject malicious JavaScript by crafting a category name that breaks out of an unescaped HTML title attribute. Attackers can create a category name containing an event-handler payload that executes in the browser of visitors who interact with the category link on the public EDD archive page, potentially compromising an administrator's session if they view the affected page while authenticated.

CVE-2026-107942.description: Improper Content Security Policy (CSP) nonce implementation in HCL BigFix MCM allows a remote attacker to reduce the effectiveness of the Content Security Policy protection mechanism via an orphaned nonce value in the style-src directive of the CSP header without a corresponding nonce attribute on any <style> or <script> element.

CVE-2026-134163.description: probe-image-size 7.4.0 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in lib/common/svg_header.js that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to block the event loop via crafted SVG doctypes. Attackers can supply SVGs with an unclosed internal subset followed by many ']' characters to trigger quadratic backtracking in probe.sync, probe(stream) or probe(url), causing repeated event loop stalls.

CVE-2026-134164.description: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an algorithmic-complexity denial of service vulnerability in lib/exif_utils.js that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying self-referencing EXIF IFDs. Attackers can submit a crafted 9.6 KB JPEG with repeated ExifIFD and InteropIFD pointers to block the Node.js event loop for about 23 seconds.

CVE-2026-134165.description: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in lib/parse_stream/avif.js that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory via attacker-declared ftyp or meta box sizes. Attackers can supply an AVIF stream or URL to probe(url) or probe(stream) declaring a huge box length, forcing the parser to buffer all received bytes and causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-134166.description: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory buffering vulnerability in parseExif in lib/parse_stream/webp.js that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory via an attacker-declared EXIF chunk length. Attackers can supply a WebP stream or URL to probe(url) or probe(stream) declaring a huge EXIF length after VP8X, causing unbounded buffering and process memory exhaustion.

CVE-2026-134167.description: devpi-web before 5.2.0 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the +doc documentation route because docs_file_exists and docs_file_path in doczip.py never confine relpath to the documentation directory. Attackers can request a relpath with a leading // or percent-encoded .. segments to read server files, including the keyfs sqlite database holding password hashes.

CVE-2026-134168.description: devpi-server before 6.21.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write files outside the +files storage root by naming a user and index '..'. Attackers can self-register a '..' user, create a '..' index, and upload release files with attacker-chosen filenames and contents into a parent of the server directory.

CVE-2026-134169.description: Qwik City before 1.20.3 (@builder.io/qwik-city) and @qwik.dev/router before 2.0.0-rc.4 contain an improperly controlled object modification vulnerability in formToObj that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite built-in function properties. Attackers can send a form POST with nested field names traversing inherited members of string values, breaking Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call process-wide until server restart.

CVE-2026-134170.description: Cesanta Mongoose 7.22 before 7.24 with the built-in TLS stack contains an out-of-bounds read in mg_timegm() that allows remote attackers to crash the process via crafted X.509 certificate validity months. Attackers can present a certificate with month '00' or out-of-range values during the handshake, before signature verification, causing an unchecked dm array index and denial of service.

CVE-2026-134171.description: Cesanta Mongoose 7.21 before 7.24 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in rx_ip6() checksum validation that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read past received packets by sending IPv6 extension headers. Attackers can send a single IPv6 TCP or ICMPv6 packet with extension headers, causing tcp6csum_ok() and icmp6csum_ok() to use the full payload length and read adjacent receive-buffer memory.

CVE-2026-134172.description: audio-separator before 0.47.2 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying malicious Demucs .th model files loaded via torch.load with weights_only=False. Local users writing to the shared /tmp/audio-separator-models/ default directory, or attackers controlling unverified model download sources, can execute code when victims run Demucs separation.

CVE-2026-16132.description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Icon API: Menu submodule of the Drupal 7 Icon API module. When a menu item is configured with the Title Wrapper option enabled, the value of the Title Wrapper Class field is output directly into an HTML attribute without sanitization or escaping. A user with the "administer menu icons" permission can inject a payload such as `title" onmouseover="alert(document.cookie)` that is rendered verbatim on every page displaying the affected menu item, executing arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of any user who interacts with the menu link. This can lead to session theft, account hijacking, and further attacks against site users. This issue affects Icon API 7.1.0.

CVE-2026-19030.description: Observable Discrepancy vulnerability in Drupal CAPTCHA for Drupal 7 allows unauthenticated attackers to test login credentials despite CAPTCHA protection. When CAPTCHA is enabled on Drupal login forms, normal form validation can still run after a missing or incorrect CAPTCHA response. This may expose credential validation feedback and allow an attacker to distinguish invalid credentials from valid credentials paired with a failed CAPTCHA. This issue affects CAPTCHA for Drupal 7: from 7.x-1.0 through 7.x-1.7.

CVE-2026-112465.description: An out-of-bounds read was addressed with improved bounds checking. This issue is fixed in iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination or read kernel memory.

CVE-2026-112603.description: A logic issue was addressed with improved checks. This issue is fixed in Xcode 27.2. An app may be able to gain root privileges.

CVE-2026-112662.description: A race condition was addressed with additional validation. This issue is fixed in iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2. An app may be able to access sensitive user data.

CVE-2026-113953.description: An integer overflow was addressed with improved input validation. This issue is fixed in iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2. Processing a maliciously crafted USD file may lead to unexpected app termination.

CVE-2026-113954.description: A use-after-free issue was addressed with improved memory management. This issue is fixed in iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2. Processing a maliciously crafted file may lead to unexpected app termination.

CVE-2026-113955.description: A cross-origin issue was addressed with improved tracking of security origins. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2. Processing maliciously crafted web content may disclose sensitive user information.

CVE-2026-114021.description: An out-of-bounds write issue was addressed with improved bounds checking. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Connecting to a malicious NFS server may lead to kernel memory corruption.

CVE-2026-114022.description: An out-of-bounds write issue was addressed with improved bounds checking. This issue is fixed in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination.

CVE-2026-114023.description: A path handling issue was addressed with improved validation. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Processing web content may lead to arbitrary code execution.

CVE-2026-114024.description: This issue was addressed with improved checks. This issue is fixed in iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, visionOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2. An app may be able to access sensitive user data.

CVE-2026-114025.description: An out-of-bounds write was addressed with improved input validation. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, tvOS 27.2. A user may be able to cause unexpected app termination or arbitrary code execution.

CVE-2026-114026.description: An out-of-bounds read was addressed with improved bounds checking. This issue is fixed in iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2. Processing a maliciously crafted font may result in the disclosure of process memory.

CVE-2026-132475.description: An out-of-bounds write issue was addressed with improved bounds checking. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination or corrupt kernel memory.

CVE-2026-131651.description: The rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'media_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.7.18 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The vulnerability is only triggerable via the Backbone.js-rendered "Load More" pagination path; the server-side PHP gallery rendering correctly escapes media_title with esc_attr() and is not affected.

CVE-2026-19793.description: The WP Import Export Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.9.32 via the 'comment' parameter. This is due to a two-stage shortcode check that evaluates the raw mapping placeholder before data substitution, causing the neutralizer to be skipped when attacker-controlled comment content containing a malicious [wpie_function] shortcode is substituted at runtime. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP callables on the server. Exploitation requires an Administrator to perform the standard Export With Settings For Import followed by a New Import migration workflow, which is a routine operational task; the attacker themselves requires no account or authentication, needing only the ability to submit a pending comment on any comments-open post.

CVE-2026-133958.description: A flaw was found in Quay. Insufficient validation of repository notification webhook URLs allows an authenticated administrator to trigger Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF). By specifying an internal URL or a redirect to an internal destination, an attacker can force the Quay worker to issue unauthorized HTTP requests to internal network locations and cloud metadata services.

CVE-2026-111067.description: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.10, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.10.26 does not guard all execution paths of its database restore process against second-order SQL injection, allowing a Subscriber-level user who has stored crafted content in their own account to escalate to administrator when an administrator later restores a backup. This is due to an incomplete fix of CVE-2026-108761 in 1.26.9: the fix guards only one of the restore routine's execution paths, and a second path remains exploitable.

CVE-2026-111975.description: The GiveWP WordPress plugin before 4.19.2.1 does not exclude donors who chose to give anonymously from one of its public REST API listings, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve those donors' names.

CVE-2026-114434.description: The Video Conferencing with Zoom WordPress plugin before 4.7.0 does not check that the requester is authorized to join a meeting before issuing a Zoom Meeting SDK signature for it, allowing unauthenticated users to obtain a valid signed join credential for an arbitrary meeting.

CVE-2026-114435.description: The Video Conferencing with Zoom WordPress plugin before 4.7.0 does not check authorization, or whether a meeting is restricted to logged-in users, password-protected or unpublished, before returning a meeting's join links, allowing unauthenticated users to obtain the passcode-embedded join links of any meeting, including meetings the site restricts.

CVE-2026-114436.description: The Video Conferencing with Zoom WordPress plugin before 4.7.0 does not check that a requested Zoom meeting's recordings were published on the site before fetching them with the site's connected Zoom account, allowing unauthenticated users who know a meeting ID to retrieve that meeting's cloud recording details, including its topic, share link, passcode when returned by Zoom, and direct play and download links.

CVE-2026-115226.description: The GiveWP WordPress plugin before 4.19.2.1 does not properly restrict access to sensitive donor information in one of its REST API endpoints, allowing any authenticated user who owns a donor record, such as a subscriber who has donated once, to retrieve the email address, phone number, name, postal address and company of all donors.

CVE-2026-119184.description: The Mapster WP Maps — Mapbox, MapLibre & Google Maps for WordPress plugin before 2.0.7 does not perform any authorization check when saving edits made through its bundled photo-gallery library, allowing any authenticated user with at least Contributor-level access to overwrite the title and content of, and write arbitrary metadata onto, any post, page or media attachment on the site regardless of ownership.

CVE-2026-119607.description: The Salon Booking System – Appointment Booking for Salons, Barbershops & Spas plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 10.31.16. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to overwrite arbitrary users' user meta fields, including the _sln_phone and _sln_sms_prefix meta of administrator accounts, and create bookings attributed to arbitrary users. This is exploitable on default installations because reCAPTCHA is disabled by default, causing the booking endpoint's permission check to return true for any authenticated user without a meaningful authorization gate.

CVE-2026-120539.description: The Restrictions for BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.4 This is due to the plugin splicing the attacker-controlled request URI into a PHP expression inside a double-quoted string and evaluating it with eval(). Because PHP interpolates double-quoted strings, a payload of the form {${...}} in the URL path is executed during interpolation, so no quote breakout is required and WordPress' slashing does not mitigate it. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the server with a single GET request. The affected conditions ship enabled by default and are evaluated before any logged-in check, so no plugin configuration is needed; the site must have BuddyPress and Paid Memberships Pro active alongside this plugin.

CVE-2026-121150.description: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not correctly handle comment-like content found in the middle of a long SQL statement when restoring a database backup, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber who have stored crafted content in their own profile to have SQL executed when an administrator later restores a backup, and so escalate their account to administrator. This is a different code path from the backup restore issue fixed in 1.26.10, and it does not depend on the database server's maximum packet size.

CVE-2026-121151.description: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not preserve long database values byte-for-byte when restoring a database backup, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to plant a serialized value that becomes a PHP Object Injection once an administrator backs up and restores the database. No gadget chain is known in the UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 or WordPress core, so the demonstrated effect is instantiation of an attacker-chosen class in the attacker's own requests. Exploitation requires the planted data to line up exactly with how the backup is read back, which depends on details of the attacker's row and the database dump format.

CVE-2026-121152.description: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not safely process the output of the external database dump tool when backing up large tables, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to store profile data that turns into SQL executed when an administrator later restores the backup, for example to grant themselves the administrator role.

CVE-2026-121153.description: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not keep a serialized value inert when their database search and replace reaches its recursion limit, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to plant data in their own user meta that is rewritten into a live PHP object when an administrator later runs a search and replace or a migration restore, and is then instantiated by WordPress on a later read. This is distinct from CVE-2024-10957, whose fix restricted the unserialize call but left this path in place. No gadget chain is present in WordPress core or the UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 themselves; further impact depends on a suitable class from another installed UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 or .

CVE-2026-121154.description: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not keep serialized string lengths consistent when their database search and replace processes certain serialized values, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to plant data that becomes an attacker-chosen PHP object after an administrator runs a URL-lengthening search and replace or a migration restore. When the replacement changes the length of the text, the declared string lengths inside the stored value no longer match and the corrupted value is written back, so when WordPress later reads it the trailing bytes are parsed as further serialized structure, including an object of a class the attacker named. No gadget chain is known in the UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 themselves; further impact depends on classes available from other installed code.

CVE-2026-121155.description: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 1.26.16 do not preserve the escaping of JSON-formatted database values when they rewrite the database during a restore to a new address or server, which could allow unauthenticated attackers to plant harmless-looking escaped markup, for example in a comment author name, that becomes Stored Cross-Site Scripting once an administrator performs such a restore.

CVE-2026-123663.description: The ProfilePress WordPress plugin before 4.18.1 takes the role for an account registered through a combined login and registration form from the separate registration form that shares its numeric ID, allowing unauthenticated users to register with the elevated role, such as Editor, assigned by an unpublished registration form.

CVE-2026-125932.description: The Coupon Creator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (with metakeyinput=cctor_expiration)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit is possible because the cctor_coupon post type advertises 'custom-fields' support, enabling WordPress core's Custom Fields metabox for Contributors, and the unregistered cctor_expiration meta key causes sanitize_meta() to be a no-op, allowing raw HTML to be stored verbatim in the database via a single AJAX request.

CVE-2026-126039.description: The Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 does not limit one of its HTML output rewriting patterns to the markup it targets, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject HTML attributes through a comment author name that execute as Stored XSS for any visitor, including logged-in administrators, on pages that list recent comments.

CVE-2026-127002.description: The RSVP and Event Management WordPress plugin before 2.7.19 does not escape a submitted value before outputting it back in its RSVP form when the form is re-displayed after a failed submission, leading to a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting which could be used against high-privilege users such as admins.

CVE-2026-130891.description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not check that a visitor is really the subscriber before showing them newsletters marked as private, and accepts a weaker subscriber identifier that anyone can obtain by submitting a known subscriber's email address to the public subscription form, allowing unauthenticated attackers who know a subscriber's email address to read every private newsletter sent to that subscriber.

CVE-2026-130892.description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not properly validate the destination of the redirect performed when a subscriber changes their list membership from a newsletter link, checking only that it begins with the site's URL, allowing unauthenticated attackers to redirect users to external sites whose address starts with the site's URL.

CVE-2026-130894.description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not protect its unsubscription actions against Cross-Site Request Forgery for subscribers it identifies from its own tracking cookie, allowing attackers to unsubscribe a subscriber from the site's newsletter by making them visit a malicious page.

CVE-2026-131971.description: The Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid WordPress plugin before 2.8.63 does not check that the visitor is allowed to view an invoice before rendering it through its single-invoice shortcode, and its payment-form embed page lets unauthenticated users render that shortcode for any invoice ID, disclosing customers' names, billing addresses, phone numbers, line items and payment status.

CVE-2026-131975.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not prevent format specifiers in a shortcode attribute from being interpreted when building navigation menu markup, which could allow users with a role as low as Contributor to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

CVE-2026-131976.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not prevent placeholders in a shortcode attribute from being expanded with unescaped nested shortcode output, allowing users with a role as low as contributor to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

CVE-2026-131977.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not escape the error message returned when a remote feed cannot be retrieved before outputting it, which could allow users with the contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators by pointing the feed at a server they control.

CVE-2026-131978.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not restrict which PHP functions a shortcode's filter attribute can call, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to remove WordPress' term-slug sanitization and perform SQL injection attacks through another shortcode's taxonomy term attribute.

CVE-2026-131979.description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not restrict the content type of its lightbox shortcode, allowing users with the contributor role and above to make the lightbox fetch HTML from an attacker-controlled server and insert it into the page unsanitised, leading to Stored Cross-Site Scripting when a user opens the lightbox.

CVE-2026-131983.description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 does not apply the per-link visibility rules of space sidebar links when listing spaces in its space discovery feature, allowing unauthenticated visitors to retrieve the titles and URLs of links restricted to logged-in users or specific memberships, as well as disabled links, for every public and private space.

CVE-2026-131984.description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.7.0 does not verify that the user is allowed to manage the space it actually modifies or deletes, allowing a user who administers any one space to modify or permanently delete any other space on the site, together with its posts, comments, reactions and memberships.

CVE-2026-131985.description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 does not verify that a referenced media item belongs to the user, or is not already attached elsewhere, before re-linking it to their own content, and its media identifiers are predictable from public post data, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to take over and delete media uploaded by other users, including administrators.

CVE-2026-132042.description: The Keywords to Links Converter WordPress plugin before 2.2.5 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement via an AJAX action available to any authenticated user, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to perform SQL injection attacks and read arbitrary data from the database.

CVE-2026-132044.description: The FluentCommunity WordPress plugin before 2.8.0 does not check that a lesson belongs to the course a course creator is authorised to manage before moving it, allowing a user with the Course Creator role to move lessons out of other creators' courses into their own and read their content.

CVE-2026-132073.description: The Keywords to Links Converter WordPress plugin before 2.2.5 does not validate a value submitted to one of its AJAX actions before saving it as an option that it later uses in an arithmetic operation on every admin and front-end request, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to make the whole site return a fatal error until the option is manually reset.

CVE-2026-132081.description: The Titan Anti-spam & Security WordPress plugin before 7.5.5 does not protect or remove the diagnostic archive it writes to the uploads folder when an administrator exports its logs, and names it after the export date alone, allowing unauthenticated visitors to download the Titan Anti-spam & Security WordPress plugin before 7.5.5's logs, including visitor IP addresses, and the site's system information.

CVE-2026-132082.description: The RSVPMaker for Toastmasters WordPress plugin before 6.9.3 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before outputting it back in an admin page, leading to a Reflected Cross-Site Scripting which could be used against high privilege users such as admin.

CVE-2026-132089.description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not keep a subscriber's secret key out of the redirect it returns after a subscription request when double opt-in is enabled, allowing unauthenticated attackers to confirm a subscription for any email address without access to its mailbox and, when the address already has an unconfirmed subscription, to reset that record with their own details.

CVE-2026-132781.description: The Booking Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the plugin's 'booking' shortcode in all versions up to, and including, 12.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping on user supplied attributes. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-133439.description: The Coupon Creator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only exploitable when an administrator has enabled the 'Disable Print View' option (cctor_hide_print_link), as this setting is required to reach the vulnerable else branch; the default configuration is not affected.

CVE-2026-133471.description: The Fastcache by Host.it plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the 's' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.14 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link.
