CVE-2026-134401.description: Improper input validation in Variations in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.88 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)
CVE-2026-134401.summary_ko: Google Chrome 158.0.8127.88 이전 버전의 Variations에 입력 검증 취약점이 있어, 원격 공격자가 샌드박스 밖에서 임의 코드를 실행할 가능성이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 조작된 웹페이지로 Chrome 샌드박스 밖 코드 실행 가능성이 있어 업데이트 필요성이 크다.

CVE-2026-129975.description: A flaw was found in gpgme. When processing crafted input, an early return following memory reallocation can leave internal buffer pointers referencing previously freed memory, resulting in a double-free condition during cleanup. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to corrupt process memory, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution or a Denial of Service (DoS) crash.
CVE-2026-129975.summary_ko: gpgme에 이중 해제 취약점이 있어 원격 공격자가 프로세스 메모리를 손상시킬 수 있습니다. 이로 인해 임의 코드 실행이나 서비스 거부(DoS)를 유발하는 충돌이 발생할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-129975.background_ko: 메모리 재할당 후 조기 반환 시 내부 버퍼 포인터가 이미 해제된 메모리를 계속 가리켜 정리 과정에서 이중 해제가 발생합니다.

curation.reason_ko: gpgme의 이중 해제로 원격 코드 실행 가능성이 있고 여러 보안 메일링리스트에서 논의됐다.

CVE-2026-135202.description: Several plugins for WordPress published by WP connect (Orders Sync to Airtable for WooCommerce, Add-On for Contact Form 7 to Notion, WP Sync for Notion – Notion to WordPress, Add-On for Contact Form 7 to Airtable, Add-on Brevo for Gravity Forms, and Air WP Sync – Airtable to WordPress) contain embedded malicious code (a backdoor) in the versions listed. The affected releases unconditionally load a backdoor module (includes/airwp-online.php) that runs on every request via the 'init' hook and on a half-hourly WP-Cron event, sends site information (site URL, PHP, WordPress and OS versions, and the server user) to a remote command-and-control server at tascredit-pay.com with TLS certificate verification disabled, and executes the PHP code returned by that server via eval(). The module also accepts queued commands that run shell commands, read, write and delete arbitrary files, query arbitrary database tables, dump the users table including password hashes, drop a webshell into the uploads directory, and install persistent hourly code execution. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers in control of the remote server, or able to intercept its traffic, to execute arbitrary code on the server and fully compromise affected sites. All affected plugins have been closed on WordPress.org and no patched versions are available; we strongly recommend uninstalling them and running a complete malware scan.
CVE-2026-135202.summary_ko: WP connect가 배포한 WordPress 플러그인 6종에 백도어가 포함돼 있습니다. 원격 제어 서버를 장악하거나 해당 통신을 가로챌 수 있는 비인증 공격자는 서버에서 임의 코드를 실행하고 사이트를 완전히 장악할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-135202.background_ko: 백도어 모듈을 무조건 불러오고, TLS 인증서 검증 없이 원격 서버와 통신하며 서버가 반환한 PHP 코드를 실행하기 때문입니다.

curation.reason_ko: WP connect 플러그인 6종에 코드 실행 백도어가 포함됐고 수정 버전이 없어 대응이 시급하다.

CVE-2026-133469.description: XO (Xen Orchestra) is a solution to visualize, manage, backup and delegate your XCP-ng (or XenServer) infrastructure. Prior to 6.9.2 and 6.10.1, REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into {}. REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string. The token collection treats {} as an unfiltered lookup and returns its first token; the provider authenticates as that token's owner if it is unexpired. The authenticated /rest/v0/users/me/authentication_tokens route then returns reusable login token IDs. This vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild. This vulnerability is fixed in 6.9.2 and 6.10.1.
CVE-2026-133469.summary_ko: Xen Orchestra의 REST 인증 취약점으로 다른 사용자로 인증하고 재사용 가능한 로그인 토큰 ID를 획득할 수 있습니다. 설명에 따르면 실제 악용 중이며, 6.9.2와 6.10.1에서 수정됐습니다.
CVE-2026-133469.background_ko: REST 인증이 쿠키에서 파싱된 객체를 문자열 검증 없이 토큰 제공자에 넘기고, 빈 객체 조회가 첫 번째 토큰을 반환하기 때문입니다.

curation.reason_ko: Xen Orchestra의 REST 인증 우회로 다른 사용자로 인증하고 재사용 로그인 토큰을 얻을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-134069.description: Use of a default cryptographic key in the instance registration component in Amazon SSM Agent before 3.3.5226.0 on AWS-provided Windows Server AMIs released before 2026-09-09 might allow local users without administrative privileges to obtain the instance's Default Host Management Configuration role credentials via the registration key shared by all instances launched from the same AMI. To remediate this issue, users should replace affected instances with instances launched from AWS Windows Server AMIs released on or after 2026-09-09, which include SSM Agent 3.3.5226.0 or later. Upgrading the agent in place does not replace the shared key, and deleting the agent's Vault breaks instances managed through Default Host Management Configuration.
CVE-2026-134069.summary_ko: 2026-09-09 이전에 출시된 AWS Windows Server AMI의 Amazon SSM Agent 3.3.5226.0 이전 버전에서, 관리자 권한이 없는 로컬 사용자가 인스턴스의 Default Host Management Configuration 역할 자격 증명을 획득할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-134069.background_ko: 인스턴스 등록 구성 요소가 기본 암호화 키를 사용하며, 같은 AMI로 생성된 모든 인스턴스가 등록 키를 공유하기 때문입니다.

curation.reason_ko: Amazon SSM Agent의 공유 키로 역할 자격 증명이 노출되며 에이전트 업데이트만으로 해결되지 않는다.

CVE-2026-62841.description: Improper authentication in Azure Event Grid allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
CVE-2026-62841.summary_ko: Azure Event Grid의 부적절한 인증으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 권한을 상승시킬 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Azure Event Grid의 인증 결함으로 권한 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다.

CVE-2026-70193.description: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-70193.summary_ko: Microsoft Office SharePoint의 경로 탐색 취약점으로 권한이 있는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-70193.background_ko: 경로명을 지정된 디렉터리 내부로 제한하는 처리가 부적절해 발생합니다.

curation.reason_ko: SharePoint의 경로 탐색 취약점으로 권한을 가진 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-130165.description: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. In versions prior to 19.0.9, 19.1.10, 19.2.9 and 19.3.1, react-server-dom-webpack, react-server-dom-parcel, and react-server-dom-turbopack are vulnerable to denial of service. Specially crafted HTTP requests sent to server function endpoints can cause out-of-memory exceptions or excessive CPU usage. This issue is fixed in versions 19.0.9, 19.1.10, 19.2.9 and 19.3.1.
CVE-2026-130165.summary_ko: React의 react-server-dom-webpack, react-server-dom-parcel, react-server-dom-turbopack에 서비스 거부 취약점이 있습니다. 서버 함수 엔드포인트에 대한 특수 제작 HTTP 요청이 메모리 부족 예외나 과도한 CPU 사용을 유발할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: React 서버 함수 엔드포인트에 조작된 요청을 보내 메모리 고갈이나 과도한 CPU 사용을 유발할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-134056.description: An out-of-bounds write issue exists in padded block cipher decryption in AWS-LC. It affects applications that decrypt CBC or ECB ciphertext with PKCS7 padding over multiple calls into the minimum documented output buffer. A remote user who supplies crafted ciphertext might crash the application or corrupt adjacent memory. Affected are all versions of AWS-LC before 5.7.0, AWS-LC-FIPS 4.x before 4.2.0, AWS-LC-FIPS 3.x before 3.6.0, and AWS-LC-FIPS 2.x before 2.0.18. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to AWS-LC 5.7.0, AWS-LC-FIPS 4.2.0, or AWS-LC-FIPS 3.6.0. AWS-LC-FIPS 2.0.18 is also fixed; AWS-LC-FIPS 2.x reaches end of support in April 2027.
CVE-2026-134056.summary_ko: AWS-LC에서 PKCS7 패딩이 적용된 CBC·ECB 암호문을 여러 차례 나누어 복호화할 때 범위 밖 쓰기가 발생할 수 있다. 원격 사용자가 제공한 암호문으로 애플리케이션이 충돌하거나 인접 메모리가 손상될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-134056.background_ko: 문서상 최소 크기의 출력 버퍼로 PKCS7 패딩 CBC·ECB 복호화를 여러 번 호출하는 과정에서 버퍼 경계를 벗어난 쓰기가 발생한다.

curation.reason_ko: AWS-LC의 패딩 블록 복호화 중 범위 밖 쓰기로 애플리케이션 충돌이나 메모리 손상이 발생할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-130169.description: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.26 through 0.7.4, AutoGPT Platform ships a publicly known, hardcoded default JWT verification key in backend/.env.default and autogpt_platform/.env.default. Because HS256 is symmetric, anyone who knows the secret can forge valid JWTs for any user or for the admin role, bypassing authentication and authorization without user interaction. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.0.
CVE-2026-130169.summary_ko: AutoGPT Platform 0.6.26~0.7.4에는 공개적으로 알려진 기본 JWT 검증 키가 하드코딩돼 있다. 이를 아는 공격자는 사용자나 관리자 JWT를 위조해 사용자 상호작용 없이 인증과 권한 검사를 우회할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-130169.background_ko: 대칭키 방식인 HS256의 JWT 검증에 공개적으로 알려진 하드코딩 기본 키를 사용한다.

curation.reason_ko: AutoGPT Platform의 공개된 기본 JWT 키로 관리자 토큰을 위조해 인증과 권한 검사를 우회할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-103782.description: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an Argument Injection vulnerability. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution and unauthorized access to filesystem resources.
CVE-2026-103782.summary_ko: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution 4.6.1 미만 버전에 인자 삽입 취약점이 있다. 낮은 권한의 원격 공격자가 임의 명령을 실행하거나 파일시스템 자원에 무단 접근할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution의 인자 삽입으로 낮은 권한의 원격 공격자가 명령을 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-103788.description: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An unauthenticated adjacent network attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution. This vulnerability is considered critical as it may allow unauthenticated command execution.
CVE-2026-103788.summary_ko: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution 4.6.1 미만 버전에 OS 명령 삽입 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 인접 네트워크 공격자가 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution에서 비인증 인접 네트워크 공격자의 OS 명령 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-82303.description: A buffer over-read vulnerability in Elasticsearch transport decompression can expose data from other requests. The LZ4 decoder can read beyond the declared compressed block into a shared network buffer. A remote attacker who can reach an affected transport interface can send a specially crafted compressed request and obtain data from outside their own request. Exploitation of the exposed remote-cluster transport interface does not require authentication.
CVE-2026-82303.summary_ko: Elasticsearch의 전송 데이터 압축 해제 과정에 버퍼 범위 밖 읽기 취약점이 있어, 전송 인터페이스에 접근 가능한 원격 공격자가 다른 요청의 데이터를 얻을 수 있다. 노출된 원격 클러스터 전송 인터페이스에서는 인증 없이 악용할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-82303.background_ko: LZ4 디코더가 선언된 압축 블록의 경계를 넘어 공유 네트워크 버퍼를 읽는다.

curation.reason_ko: Elasticsearch의 압축 해제 결함으로 노출된 원격 클러스터 전송 인터페이스에서 비인증 데이터 유출이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-82981.description: SQL injection in WHMCS could allow an unauthenticated user to retrieve clients' personal and support information, as well as administrator account records and password hashes.
CVE-2026-82981.summary_ko: WHMCS의 SQL 삽입 취약점으로 인증되지 않은 사용자가 고객의 개인정보와 지원 관련 정보, 관리자 계정 기록 및 비밀번호 해시를 조회할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: WHMCS의 비인증 SQL 삽입으로 고객 개인정보와 관리자 계정 기록·비밀번호 해시가 노출될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-93700.description: An authenticated WHMCS client could potentially leverage this flaw to read sensitive configuration files on the WHMCS host, including database credentials, and to execute code on the server.
CVE-2026-93700.summary_ko: WHMCS의 인증된 클라이언트가 호스트에서 데이터베이스 자격 증명이 포함된 민감한 설정 파일을 읽고, 서버에서 코드를 실행할 가능성이 있는 취약점입니다.

curation.reason_ko: WHMCS의 인증된 고객이 데이터베이스 자격 증명을 읽거나 서버 코드를 실행할 가능성이 있다.

CVE-2026-134841.description: pgjdbc, the PostgreSQL JDBC Driver, misreads some quoted text in its query parser. A `}` inside a literal ends a JDBC escape such as `{ts}`, and the rest of the literal is translated as SQL. A dollar quote whose tag has a non-ASCII symbol or space is not recognized. An `E''` string with a doubled quote is scanned as a standard string. `{fn right}` and `{fn timestampdiff}` with a negative argument produce a `--` comment. In each case text that the application quoted correctly can run as SQL with the privileges of the application's database role. All versions before 42.7.15 are affected, and 42.7.15 fixes the problem.
CVE-2026-134841.summary_ko: PostgreSQL JDBC 드라이버 pgjdbc 42.7.15 이전 버전의 쿼리 파서 취약점으로, 애플리케이션이 올바르게 인용 처리한 텍스트도 애플리케이션의 데이터베이스 역할 권한으로 SQL로 실행될 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-134841.background_ko: 쿼리 파서가 일부 문자열 리터럴과 JDBC 이스케이프 구문을 잘못 해석해 인용된 텍스트를 SQL로 처리하기 때문입니다.

curation.reason_ko: pgjdbc 쿼리 파서 오류로 올바르게 인용한 텍스트도 애플리케이션의 데이터베이스 권한으로 실행될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-134842.description: pgjdbc, the PostgreSQL JDBC Driver, can quote a string parameter for the wrong value of standard_conforming_strings when preferQueryMode=simple is set. A statement, trigger or configuration reload can turn the setting off during a session. A parameter value with a backslash and a quote then ends the literal, and the rest of the value runs as SQL. Before 42.7.6 any session with the setting off was affected. The statement cache can also reuse a parse made under the other setting. With allowEncodingChanges=true and the EUC_JP or SJIS client encoding, the yen sign acts as a backslash. All versions before 42.7.15 are affected, and 42.7.15 fixes the problem.
CVE-2026-134842.summary_ko: PostgreSQL JDBC 드라이버 pgjdbc 42.7.15 이전 버전에서 단순 쿼리 모드 사용 시 문자열 매개변수 인용 처리에 오류가 생길 수 있습니다. 그 결과 매개변수 값의 일부가 SQL로 실행될 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-134842.background_ko: standard_conforming_strings 설정과 다른 기준으로 문자열을 인용하거나, 설정이 다른 상태에서 생성된 구문 분석 결과를 캐시에서 재사용하기 때문입니다.

curation.reason_ko: pgjdbc의 단순 쿼리 모드에서 문자열 설정과 인용 처리의 불일치로 매개변수 값이 SQL로 실행될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-134843.description: pgjdbc, the PostgreSQL JDBC Driver, does not close the connection when an unchecked exception interrupts a request. Part of a Bind message stays in the send buffer, and the server reads the bytes that follow as the rest of it. The bytes of a value uploaded later on the same connection can then run as a SQL command. Since 42.6.0 a setBinaryStream() value without a length that is executed again throws such an exception, as does the driver's own retry after SQLState 0A000 or 26000. An application stream that throws an unchecked exception has the same effect in all versions. All versions before 42.7.15 are affected, and 42.7.15 fixes the problem.
CVE-2026-134843.summary_ko: PostgreSQL JDBC 드라이버인 pgjdbc 42.7.15 미만 버전에서는 요청이 비검사 예외로 중단된 뒤, 같은 연결로 나중에 전송된 값이 SQL 명령으로 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-134843.background_ko: 비검사 예외로 요청이 중단돼도 연결을 닫지 않아 Bind 메시지 일부가 송신 버퍼에 남고, 이후 데이터가 그 나머지로 해석된다.

curation.reason_ko: pgjdbc가 예외 후 연결을 닫지 않아 같은 연결로 나중에 전송한 값이 SQL 명령으로 실행될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-134844.description: pgjdbc, the PostgreSQL JDBC Driver, uses unqualified operators and functions in the catalog queries of DatabaseMetaData, ResultSetMetaData and TypeInfoCache. A role with CREATE on a schema of the application's search_path can add an operator with an exact type match, and the server runs it with the privileges of the application's role. TypeInfoCache also resolves an unqualified type name such as interval by its own ranking. A domain with that name in another schema, even the temporary schema of another session, can be used instead, and its CHECK runs in the application's session. All versions before 42.7.15 are affected, and 42.7.15 fixes the problem.
CVE-2026-134844.summary_ko: pgjdbc 42.7.15 미만 버전에서는 애플리케이션의 search_path 내 스키마에 CREATE 권한이 있는 역할이 연산자를 추가해 애플리케이션 권한으로 실행되게 할 수 있다. 타입 해석 시 다른 스키마 도메인의 CHECK가 애플리케이션 세션에서 실행될 수도 있다.
CVE-2026-134844.background_ko: 메타데이터 조회에 스키마가 지정되지 않은 연산자·함수를 사용하고, TypeInfoCache가 스키마 없는 타입명을 자체 순위로 해석한다.

curation.reason_ko: pgjdbc의 스키마를 한정하지 않은 연산자·타입 조회로 공격자 객체가 애플리케이션 권한으로 실행될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-134845.description: pgjdbc, the PostgreSQL JDBC Driver, does not enforce TLS for some settings that ask for it. When sslmode is not set, an ssl value such as 1, on, yes or verify-full gives sslmode=prefer, or no TLS before 42.2.5. A service given in the Properties instead of the URL is ignored, so the sslmode of its pg_service.conf entry is lost. BaseDataSource.setUrl() keeps an sslmode, channelBinding or gssEncMode that was set before it. An attacker on the network path can then read and change the traffic. Versions 9.4.1208 through 42.7.14 are affected, and 42.7.15 fixes the problem.
CVE-2026-134845.summary_ko: PostgreSQL JDBC 드라이버인 pgjdbc 9.4.1208~42.7.14에서는 TLS를 요구하는 일부 설정이 강제되지 않습니다. 네트워크 경로상의 공격자가 통신 내용을 읽거나 변경할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-134845.background_ko: 일부 ssl 값이 TLS 필수가 아닌 설정으로 해석되고, Properties의 service가 무시되며, BaseDataSource.setUrl()이 기존 보안 옵션을 유지합니다.

curation.reason_ko: pgjdbc가 TLS를 요구하는 일부 설정을 강제하지 않아 네트워크 경로상의 공격자가 통신을 읽거나 바꿀 수 있다.

CVE-2026-124851.description: An information disclosure vulnerability in Zstandard versions 1.5.1 through 1.5.7 allows specially crafted compressed data to expose the contents of an internal buffer through decompressed output. The buffer is 64 KiB in the default configuration and may contain uninitialized memory or literals from earlier decompressions performed using the same decompression context. An attacker who can submit compressed data and observe the resulting output can recover the buffer's contents.
CVE-2026-124851.summary_ko: Zstandard 1.5.1~1.5.7에서 조작된 압축 데이터를 해제하면 내부 버퍼 내용이 출력에 노출될 수 있다. 여기에는 초기화되지 않은 메모리나 같은 컨텍스트에서 이전에 압축 해제한 데이터가 포함될 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Zstandard의 조작된 압축 데이터로 내부 버퍼와 이전 압축 해제 데이터가 출력에 노출될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-50691.description: Improper authorization in M365 Copilot allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
CVE-2026-50691.summary_ko: M365 Copilot의 부적절한 권한 부여로 인해 권한이 있는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 권한을 상승시킬 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: M365 Copilot의 권한 부여 결함으로 권한을 가진 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다.

CVE-2026-118286.description: Improper access control in Azure Site Recovery allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
CVE-2026-118286.summary_ko: Azure Site Recovery의 접근 제어 취약점으로 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 권한을 상승시킬 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Azure Site Recovery의 접근 제어 결함으로 권한 없는 공격자가 원격으로 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다.

CVE-2026-118285.description: Server-side request forgery in Azure Machine Learning allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
CVE-2026-118285.summary_ko: Azure Machine Learning의 서버 측 요청 위조(SSRF) 취약점으로 권한이 있는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Azure Machine Learning의 서버 측 요청 위조로 권한을 가진 공격자가 원격으로 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다.

CVE-2026-135208.description: Kerberos Agent before 3.14.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens because JWTMiddleWare() falls back to the hard-coded key TOBECHANGED. Attackers can sign HS256 tokens with arbitrary username and role claims to access /api and /config routes, exposing RTSP, ONVIF, Hub and encryption keys, rewriting configuration, and stopping the camera.
CVE-2026-135208.summary_ko: Kerberos Agent 3.14.4 이전 버전에는 인증되지 않은 공격자가 관리자 토큰을 위조할 수 있는 인증 우회 취약점이 있습니다. 민감한 키 노출, 설정 변경 및 카메라 중지로 이어질 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-135208.background_ko: JWTMiddleWare()가 하드코딩된 키를 대체 키로 사용해 관리자 토큰 위조가 가능합니다.

curation.reason_ko: Kerberos Agent의 하드코딩된 JWT 키로 관리자 인증을 우회해 카메라 키 탈취와 설정 변경이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-135736.description: FFmpeg 4.4 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_deband.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by sending a runtime coupling command. Attackers can send a 'deband coupling 1' command via sendcmd or an unauthenticated zmq filter, making chroma planes be processed at luma dimensions to crash the process or potentially execute code.
CVE-2026-135736.summary_ko: FFmpeg의 deband 필터에는 힙 경계 밖 읽기·쓰기 취약점이 있습니다. 런타임 설정 변경으로 힙 메모리가 손상되어 프로세스가 중단되거나 코드가 실행될 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-135736.background_ko: 런타임 결합 설정 변경 시 색차 평면을 휘도 평면의 크기로 처리합니다.

curation.reason_ko: FFmpeg deband 필터의 런타임 명령 처리로 힙이 손상돼 충돌이나 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.

CVE-2026-135743.description: FFmpeg 4.3 before 9.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in the dynaudnorm filter because cqueue_resize() miscalculates gain history queue element counts when gausssize changes at runtime. Attackers can send gausssize commands via asendcmd scripts or an unauthenticated azmq filter to corrupt heap memory, crashing the process or potentially executing code.
CVE-2026-135743.summary_ko: FFmpeg의 dynaudnorm 필터에는 런타임 설정 변경 시 힙 경계 밖 읽기·쓰기가 발생하는 취약점이 있습니다. 힙 메모리 손상으로 프로세스가 중단되거나 코드가 실행될 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-135743.background_ko: gausssize가 런타임에 변경될 때 cqueue_resize()가 게인 이력 큐의 요소 수를 잘못 계산합니다.

curation.reason_ko: FFmpeg dynaudnorm 필터의 큐 크기 계산 오류로 런타임 설정 변경 시 힙 손상과 코드 실행 가능성이 있다.

CVE-2026-134880.description: XML::Sig versions before 0.74 for Perl allow code execution via a document's Algorithm attribute that verify resolves to a function name and calls. The text after the last `#` in the DigestMethod and SignatureMethod Algorithm attributes is looked up with Digest::SHA->can. That returns a code reference for any fully qualified function name, Perl builtins in the CORE namespace included. The digest function is called on the canonical form of the referenced element, so the document picks both the function and its argument. An attacker who can submit a signed document can run a command as the verifying process.
CVE-2026-134880.summary_ko: Perl용 XML::Sig 0.74 미만 버전에는 서명 문서 검증 중 코드 실행이 가능한 취약점이 있다. 서명 문서를 제출할 수 있는 공격자는 검증 프로세스 권한으로 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-134880.background_ko: 문서의 Algorithm 속성에서 결정된 함수명을 검증 과정에서 호출하며, 호출할 함수와 그 인자를 모두 문서가 결정한다.

curation.reason_ko: XML::Sig의 서명 검증 중 공격자가 지정한 함수가 호출돼 검증 프로세스 권한으로 명령을 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-124283.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in ash-project ash allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or inject SQL through a forged keyset pagination cursor. Ash.Page.Keyset.filter/4 in lib/ash/page/keyset.ex decodes the client-supplied page[:after] or page[:before] cursor from Erlang external term format and rejects decoded expressions with Ash.Expr.expr?/1. That check does not examine the fields of a struct. The cast of each value against the type of its sort field accepts structs for the :ci_string, :map, :struct and :term types. A struct in the cursor value for such a sort field therefore reaches the data layer. With AshPostgres, the read passes such a struct to inspect/1, which runs the Inspect implementation of the struct module that the attacker selected. A chain of struct modules from ecto and db_connection then calls a function that the cursor names, which permits OS command execution. An %Ash.Query.Function.Fragment{} inside an %Ash.CiString{} value is written into the SQL query as raw text. This issue affects ash: from 3.31.3 before 3.38.0.
CVE-2026-124283.summary_ko: ash-project의 ash 3.31.3 이상 3.38.0 미만 버전에 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 위조된 키셋 페이지네이션 커서로 임의 코드를 실행하거나 SQL을 삽입할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-124283.background_ko: 클라이언트 커서를 역직렬화한 뒤 구조체 내부 필드를 검사하지 않고, 일부 정렬 필드 타입에서 구조체를 허용해 데이터 계층으로 전달한다.

curation.reason_ko: ash의 위조 페이지네이션 커서 역직렬화로 비인증 공격자의 코드 실행이나 SQL 삽입이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-121016.description: The affected products insufficiently restrict runtime-supplied visualization data, allowing local program execution on the engineering workstation, if a user is both logged in to a CODESYS Control runtime and operates a visualization. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious runtime and tricking a user to trust it, or performing a man-in-the-middle attack on the communication between the CODESYS Control runtime and the engineering workstation, may cause arbitrary code execution on the engineering workstation.
CVE-2026-121016.summary_ko: 사용자가 CODESYS Control 런타임에 로그인한 채 시각화를 사용할 때, 엔지니어링 워크스테이션에서 로컬 프로그램 실행을 유발할 수 있습니다. 미인증 원격 공격자는 사용자가 신뢰한 악성 런타임이나 중간자 공격을 통해 임의 코드 실행을 유발할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-121016.background_ko: 런타임이 제공하는 시각화 데이터를 충분히 제한하지 않아 엔지니어링 워크스테이션에서 로컬 프로그램 실행이 가능합니다.

curation.reason_ko: CODESYS 런타임의 시각화 데이터 제한 미흡으로 사용 중인 엔지니어링 워크스테이션에서 프로그램 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-121017.description: The affected products insufficiently restrict runtime-supplied visualization data, allowing to invoke local COM/ActiveX functionality on the engineering workstation, if a user is both logged in to a CODESYS Control runtime and operates a visualization. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious runtime and tricking a user to trust it, or performing a man-in-the-middle attack on the communication between the CODESYS Control runtime and the engineering workstation, may cause arbitrary code execution on the engineering workstation.
CVE-2026-121017.summary_ko: 사용자가 CODESYS Control 런타임에 로그인한 채 시각화를 사용할 때, 엔지니어링 워크스테이션의 로컬 COM/ActiveX 기능 호출을 유발할 수 있습니다. 미인증 원격 공격자는 사용자가 신뢰한 악성 런타임이나 중간자 공격을 통해 임의 코드 실행을 유발할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-121017.background_ko: 런타임이 제공하는 시각화 데이터를 충분히 제한하지 않아 엔지니어링 워크스테이션의 로컬 COM/ActiveX 기능 호출이 가능합니다.

curation.reason_ko: CODESYS 시각화 데이터의 COM/ActiveX 호출 제한 미흡으로 워크스테이션에서 코드가 실행될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-121018.description: The affected products insufficiently restrict runtime-supplied visualization commands, allowing local functionality on the engineering workstation to be invoked, if a user is both logged in to a CODESYS Control runtime and operates a visualization. An unauthenticated remote attacker controlling a malicious runtime and tricking a user to trust it, or performing a man-in-the-middle attack on the communication between the CODESYS Control runtime and the engineering workstation, may cause arbitrary code execution on the engineering workstation.
CVE-2026-121018.summary_ko: 사용자가 CODESYS Control 런타임에 로그인한 채 시각화를 사용할 때, 엔지니어링 워크스테이션의 로컬 기능 호출을 유발할 수 있습니다. 미인증 원격 공격자는 사용자가 신뢰한 악성 런타임이나 중간자 공격을 통해 임의 코드 실행을 유발할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-121018.background_ko: 런타임이 제공하는 시각화 명령을 충분히 제한하지 않아 엔지니어링 워크스테이션의 로컬 기능 호출이 가능합니다.

curation.reason_ko: CODESYS 런타임이 공급하는 시각화 명령의 제한 미흡으로 워크스테이션의 로컬 기능을 악용할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-135287.description: LiteLLM Proxy 1.62.4 before 1.84.0 contains a callback injection vulnerability that allows authenticated API key holders to register process-wide logging callbacks by supplying callbacks fields in request bodies. Attackers can name an unenabled observability integration such as langsmith or langfuse to leak all users' prompts and responses, or suppress operator logging via litellm_disabled_callbacks.
CVE-2026-135287.summary_ko: LiteLLM Proxy에 콜백 주입 취약점이 있어 인증된 API 키 보유자가 모든 사용자의 프롬프트와 응답을 유출하거나 운영자 로깅을 비활성화할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-135287.background_ko: 인증된 API 키 보유자가 요청 본문에 지정한 콜백을 프로세스 전역 로깅 콜백으로 등록할 수 있도록 허용합니다.

curation.reason_ko: LiteLLM Proxy의 전역 콜백 주입으로 API 키 보유자가 다른 사용자들의 프롬프트·응답을 유출할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-96457.description: A flaw was found in the administrative interface of Keycloak, an identity and access management solution. The issue occurs when Fine-Grained Admin Permissions are used to restrict a group administrator from managing specific sub-groups. Due to an incomplete fix for a previous vulnerability, a restricted administrator can bypass these restrictions by moving a forbidden sub-group to the top level of the hierarchy. This allows the attacker to gain unauthorized control over the groups members, potentially leading to a full takeover of the security realm.
CVE-2026-96457.summary_ko: Keycloak 관리 인터페이스에서 세분화된 관리자 권한으로 설정한 하위 그룹 관리 제한을 우회할 수 있습니다. 제한된 관리자가 그룹 구성원을 무단으로 제어할 수 있으며, 보안 영역 전체 장악으로 이어질 가능성이 있습니다.
CVE-2026-96457.background_ko: 이전 취약점에 대한 수정이 불완전해 하위 그룹 관리 제한을 우회할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Keycloak의 불완전한 이전 수정으로 하위 그룹 관리 제한을 우회해 보안 영역 전체를 장악할 가능성이 있다.

CVE-2026-49960.description: DreameHome cloud API before 2026-10-14 contained an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the POST /smart-app/meari-cloud/redirectAndLogin endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to obtain another user's Meari camera-platform identity and session credentials by supplying that user's uid. The endpoint used the caller-supplied uid to select the Meari account without verifying that it belonged to the account authenticated by the Dreame-Auth token. Attackers can obtain target uids through public forum profiles and an email-to-uid lookup, and use the leaked credentials to access live video, microphone audio, the camera speaker, and stored recordings of Meari-backed cameras.
CVE-2026-49960.summary_ko: DreameHome 클라우드 API의 안전하지 않은 직접 객체 참조 취약점으로 인증된 공격자가 다른 사용자의 Meari 계정 식별 정보와 세션 자격 증명을 얻을 수 있습니다. 이를 통해 Meari 기반 카메라의 실시간 영상·마이크 음성, 스피커, 저장 녹화에 접근할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-49960.background_ko: 호출자가 제공한 uid가 Dreame-Auth 토큰으로 인증된 계정에 속하는지 확인하지 않고 해당 uid로 Meari 계정을 선택했습니다.

curation.reason_ko: DreameHome 계정 소유권 검사 누락으로 타인의 카메라 세션을 얻어 영상·음성과 녹화에 접근할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-49961.description: DreameHome MQTT broker before 2026-10-26 contained an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to subscribe to another device's status topic /status/{DID}/{UID}/{model}/# without owning or having access to the device. Attackers who know the device DID, owner UID, and model can receive the device's telemetry, including compressed LiDAR map frames exposing the home's layout, the Wi-Fi SSID and BSSID, local IP address, gateway, firmware version, and the session key used for encrypted video.
CVE-2026-49961.summary_ko: 2026년 10월 26일 이전 DreameHome MQTT 브로커의 잘못된 인가로, 기기 DID·소유자 UID·모델을 아는 인증된 공격자가 접근 권한이 없는 기기의 정보를 수신할 수 있다. 집 구조가 담긴 LiDAR 지도, Wi-Fi SSID·BSSID, 로컬 IP·게이트웨이, 펌웨어 버전과 암호화 영상용 세션 키가 노출될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-49961.background_ko: MQTT 브로커의 잘못된 인가 처리로 기기 소유권이나 접근 권한이 없는 사용자의 상태 토픽 구독을 허용한다.

curation.reason_ko: DreameHome MQTT 구독 권한 결함으로 타인 기기의 집 내부 지도와 네트워크 정보·영상 키가 노출될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-134020.description: OpenEMR is a free and open source electronic health records and medical practice management application. Prior to 8.5.0, the staff-facing portal endpoints GET api/onsiteactivityviews and GET api/onsiteactivityview/{id}, mapped to OnsiteActivityView.Query and OnsiteActivityView.Read with p_acl = p_none in portal/patient/_app_config.php, are handled without an authorization check for an authenticated staff session whose bootstrap_pid is empty. portal/patient/_machine_config.php admits that authenticated staff session, and portal/patient/fwk/libs/verysimple/Phreeze/GenericRouter.php applies the route ACL only when bootstrap_pid is nonempty, so the staff request bypasses the p_none check. OnsiteActivityViewController::Query() returns records without patient scoping, and OnsiteActivityViewController::Read() loads a record by identifier without checking ACL or ownership; OnsiteActivityViewReporter::GetCustomQuery() joins portal activity to patient demographics and includes names, dates of birth, addresses, and Social Security numbers. Any authenticated staff account, including one without the patients/demo permission, can therefore read sensitive demographics for patients represented by an existing onsite_portal_activity row; at least one such row must exist for the endpoint to return patient data. This issue is fixed in version 8.5.0.
CVE-2026-134020.summary_ko: OpenEMR 8.5.0 이전 버전의 직원용 포털 조회 기능에 권한 검사 누락이 있습니다. 환자 정보 조회 권한이 없는 인증된 직원도 기존 포털 활동 기록에 연결된 환자의 이름·생년월일·주소·사회보장번호를 읽을 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-134020.background_ko: bootstrap_pid가 빈 직원 세션에는 라우트 ACL이 적용되지 않고, 조회 처리에도 환자 범위·접근 권한·소유권 검사가 없습니다.

curation.reason_ko: OpenEMR에서 환자 조회 권한이 없는 인증 직원도 포털 활동 기록에 연결된 환자의 민감정보를 읽을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-109490.description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') in Authentication Methods Portal Extension allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
CVE-2026-109490.summary_ko: Authentication Methods Portal Extension의 크로스 사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점으로 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다.
CVE-2026-109490.background_ko: 웹 페이지 생성 과정에서 입력값을 적절히 무력화하지 않는다.

curation.reason_ko: Authentication Methods Portal Extension의 XSS로 권한 없는 공격자가 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다.

CVE-2026-114203.description: An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command（'OS Command Injection') in the ASUS GPU Tweak III allows a remote user to execute arbitrary OS commands via a crafted request to an HTTP endpoint of the service. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS GPU Tweak III ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.
CVE-2026-114203.summary_ko: ASUS GPU Tweak III에 OS 명령 삽입 취약점이 있다. 원격 사용자가 서비스의 HTTP 엔드포인트를 통해 임의의 OS 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-114203.background_ko: OS 명령에 사용되는 특수 요소를 적절히 무력화하지 않는다.

curation.reason_ko: ASUS GPU Tweak III의 HTTP 엔드포인트에 조작된 요청을 보내 원격으로 OS 명령을 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-132779.description: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use TLS 1.3 early data using the ssl_early_data on directive, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS 1.3 connection to drive an NGINX worker into a tight loop in which it repeatedly retries the same send without ever making progress. The worker continues accepting new connections and handling existing ones, but one CPU core is pinned at 100%. Impact: System performance can degrade until the NGINX worker process is either forced to restart or is manually restarted. This vulnerability may allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause a degradation of service that can lead to a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.
CVE-2026-132779.summary_ko: TLS 1.3 조기 데이터가 활성화된 NGINX Plus 또는 NGINX Open Source에서 인증되지 않은 공격자가 CPU 코어 하나의 사용률을 100%로 만들 수 있다. 워커가 재시작될 때까지 성능 저하가 지속될 수 있으며, 서비스 거부(DoS)로 이어질 수 있는 데이터 플레인 취약점이다.
CVE-2026-132779.background_ko: TLS 1.3 조기 데이터 사용 시 특정하게 조작된 연결로 워커가 진전 없이 같은 전송을 반복 재시도하는 루프에 빠진다.

curation.reason_ko: TLS 1.3 조기 데이터를 활성화한 NGINX에서 비인증 공격자가 작업자 CPU를 소진해 서비스를 저하시킬 수 있다.

d2236761e0775cd0e25caf8c.summary_ko: GL.iNet은 클라우드 원격 관리 서비스 취약점이 악용돼 고객 라우터와 KVM 기기에 악성코드가 설치됐다고 확인했다. 회사는 취약점 수정과 공격 경로 차단을 완료했지만 이미 감염된 기기의 악성코드는 제거되지 않는다고 밝혔다. 구체적인 악용 방식과 피해 규모는 공개하지 않았으며, 이용자에게 감염 점검과 최신 보안 펌웨어 설치를 권고했다.

curation.reason_ko: GL.iNet이 클라우드 원격관리 취약점을 통한 라우터·KVM 악성코드 감염을 확인했다.

8c916d4f71f4fa3dda6e2ff2.title_ko: Signal, iOS·Android에서 Siri·Gemini의 대화 화면 접근 차단
8c916d4f71f4fa3dda6e2ff2.summary_ko: Signal이 iOS 27과 지원되는 Android 기기에서 운영체제 AI 비서의 대화 화면 접근을 막는 보호 기능을 발표했다. iOS에서는 사용자의 일반 스크린샷 촬영도 차단되며, Android에서는 AI 비서의 화면 접근을 감지하면 화면 보안을 자동 활성화한다고 설명했다. 다만 다른 접근 경로가 남을 수 있고, macOS에서는 스크린샷 차단 기능을 제공하지 못한다고 밝혔다.
8c916d4f71f4fa3dda6e2ff2.background_ko: Signal은 운영체제에 통합된 AI 비서가 대화 화면을 수집해 민감한 정보를 앱의 통제 밖으로 가져갈 수 있다는 우려로 보호 기능을 마련했다.

curation.reason_ko: Signal이 지원 기기에서 AI 비서의 대화 캡처를 막는 개인정보 보호 기능을 발표했다.

06fc8704d420c3fcb10931d5.title_original: Adding One More Agent: How AI Team Size and Formation Shape Productivity and Diversity in Human-AI Brainstorming Teams
06fc8704d420c3fcb10931d5.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative AI has improved individual productivity, but whether adding a plurality of AI partners helps or hurts remains open. We crossed AI partnership (one versus two) with behavioral formation (calibrated to average human behavior versus customized by the participant) in a brainstorming experiment ($N$=168) with human-human dyads as reference. Two-AI rooms posted more ideas to the shared board, but human-authored ideas dropped substantially. With one AI partner, formation mattered: humans paired with an average-calibrated AI posted more than any other condition. With two, this effect vanished. Humans continued talking but converted fewer ideas into board posts. AI social talk predicted more human posts, while AI posting volume predicted fewer. AI presence increased global diversity of human-authored ideas, but only a second AI increased within-session differentiation. The number of AI partners and their formation can reshape what the human contributes; single-agent results do not generalize to multi-agent teams.

68f87e77532a60f766d16089.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded. We study an alternative paradigm, generation by simulation: rather than describing a relational artifact, we simulate a process that produces it and take the artifact to be its causal record. Language-model agents propose intent and a deterministic referee resolves outcomes against an explicit world model, so a relation is emitted only when the event it represents occurs, making coherence a property of construction. We instantiate the paradigm for cyber threat intelligence knowledge graphs in the STIX 2.1 standard with three engines, among them an evolutionary engine applying language-model genetic operators to structured graph genomes, sharing a deterministic compiler that makes malformed and dangling output unrepresentable. We prove referential closure, causal grounding, and identifier stability, an ablation localizes each to the referee and world model rather than the policy, and two independent LLM judges reproduce the rubric's engine ranking. Our central result is cautionary, and we prove it: a validator reading any graph feature set a structure-matched random graph can reproduce is uninformative about coherence for a coherence-by-construction generator. db906cde84b7b71ee315d0a1.title_original: TOUMAII: A 4.5M-Pair Tool-Calling Preference Dataset and Its Source-Agnostic Generator
db906cde84b7b71ee315d0a1.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26722v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To autonomously execute multi-step tasks, enterprise agents must reliably interact with tools, call APIs, or query databases, making tool-calling a fundamental capability of AI models. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) optimises for producing the correct call, but never contrasts it with a plausible incorrect one. In an environment where even a minor formatting error can invalidate a call and an incorrect decision can derail the interaction, direct preference optimisation (DPO) targets exactly this contrast. DPO, therefore, requires preference pairs rather than plain demonstrations. For tool-calling, such data, especially in realistic multi-turn settings, remains extremely scarce. To address this scarcity, we introduce TOUMAII, a large-scale tool-calling preference dataset containing ~4.5M validated preference pairs, derived from Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M (apache-2.0) conversations. The dataset consists of multi- and single-turn interactions and includes parallel and sequential function calls. Additionally, we release TOUMAII-Gen, a synthetic data generation pipeline that consumes tool-calling SFT datasets and generates a preference dataset with naturally occurring model-generated tool-calling failure modes. To validate the effectiveness of our DPO data, we fine-tune a 3-billion-parameter model, achieving performance parity with other high-quality tool-calling preference datasets. 7de228a507b1d516ef20485a.title_original: ChatAtom: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Molecular Dynamics Simulation and Visualization
7de228a507b1d516ef20485a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation resolves atomic-scale motion and predicts the structural, mechanical, and dynamic properties of materials, making it cen- tral to materials design and discovery. Yet an MD study requires an expert-driven workflow: designing the simulation, writing reliable input scripts, executing them, and analyzing the results with separate tools. Here we present ChatAtom, a multi-agent large language model system that translates a natural-language request into a complete MD workflow without the user writing input scripts or analysis code. Each agent has a defined responsibility within the workflow. An orchestrator plans the study; the LAMMPS and OVITO agents each use a generator-reviewer pair to prepare and review simulation and visualization scripts before execution; a high-performance computing agent dispatches jobs to remote resources; and an analysis agent interprets the completed run. The work- flow is accessible through a browser interface that streams thermodynamic data and rendered frames during local execution, allowing users to follow the simu- lation as it progresses. The architecture also supports new capabilities through loadable skills without modifying the agents, enabling autonomous hypothesis generation and testing. 742ed05ac2c8705f9c1f5699.title_original: Beyond Final Answers: Interpretable Tumor Immune Microenvironment Reasoning from H&E and mIF
742ed05ac2c8705f9c1f5699.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26794v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Readouts of the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME), such as CD8+ T-cell density, intra-epithelial infiltration and the Ki67 index, combine tissue architecture from H&E with cell phenotypes from multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF). Pathology MLLMs read H&E alone, while these readouts need the cell phenotypes that mIF measures. And their reasoning has no step-level truth to be checked against, so R1-style reinforcement learning rewards only the final answer and leaves the reasoning unverified. Same-section H&E and mIF provide what both gaps lack: mIF measures every cell without manual annotation, which gives cell-level ground truth for each step that clinical guidelines prescribe, from delineating a tissue compartment to counting and normalizing the marker-positive cells within it. We therefore present HERMES (H&E-mIF Reasoning with Multimodal Evidence Supervision), an R1-style MLLM that reasons jointly over paired H&E and mIF in guideline steps and is trained with a process reward that checks every stated quantity against this truth. Across four field-level TIME tasks in colorectal cancer, HERMES (4B) reaches an average accuracy of 84.5%, compared with 74.7% for the strongest of twelve proprietary, general, medical and pathology MLLMs, and a higher share of its intermediate quantities is correct than for the strongest

ab7e9901808947adce30750a.title_original: Memorization and Generalization in Generative Models: A Perspective From Energy-based Modeling and Associative Memory
ab7e9901808947adce30750a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative models now write working code, produce realistic images, and hold long conversations, yet the mechanisms behind their intelligence still evade our understanding. This thesis explores that puzzle through Associative Memory (AM), in which patterns are stored as energy minima and retrieved through attractor dynamics. Beyond their capacity, AMs form new minima known as spurious states, long regarded as a failure of memory. We argue that this failure is where creativity begins, and that memorization and generalization can coexist as outcomes of one retrieval process. First, we show that diffusion models behave as AMs. With little data, a diffusion model forms a distinct basin of attraction around each training sample. As the data grows, these basins shrink, and spurious states emerge as attractors that blend stored samples yet match none of them. They are the first signs of generative capability. We characterize this transition by measuring the volume, energy, and curvature of these basins across datasets and architectures, including Stable Diffusion. We then turn to language and move beyond the energy-based view of AM. We show that uniform-state discrete diffusion models are AMs capable of retrieving unseen data, with basins of attraction that arise from conditional likelihood maximization alone. 279c9c3889ad0bcfc6f1ff23.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26870v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, where they must distinguish between normative reasoning (what should happen) and descriptive reasoning (what is likely to happen). Most fairness benchmarks evaluate demographic discrimination under a single reasoning objective, and none we know of tests whether a model treats the same item differently when asked to describe an outcome versus decide one. c4556738d4efe72392ed0e60.title_original: Towards Robust Partial-Edit Deepfake Localization: An edit and Generator Conditioned Analysis
c4556738d4efe72392ed0e60.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26903v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Partial-edit deepfake localization aims to identify manipulated regions within otherwise authentic speech. Recent systems report strong overall results, but aggregate scores do not reveal whether this performance holds across different editing conditions. In this work, we present an edit- and generator-conditioned analysis of Segment-Aware Localization (SAL) using WavLM-Large and XLS-R representations on the VoiceCraft and SSR-Speech subsets of PartialEdit. We categorize edits along three transcript-derived axes, namely content, meaning change, and editing operation, and evaluate each generator separately. While both representations achieve strong overall performance, localization is noticeably weaker on SSR-Speech. From our experiments, we found that the deletion is the hardest operation, and deletions produced by SSR-Speech are the most challenging condition for both representations. In contrast, edit content, meaning change, and sentence novelty have smaller effects. These findings show that a single aggregate score can mask important weaknesses, and that partial-edit localization should be evaluated separately across generators and edit types.

b02f8475f9518603309f3a86.title_original: Budget-Aware Predict-and-Verify Theorem Proving with Heterogeneous LLM Solvers
b02f8475f9518603309f3a86.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) theorem solvers differ in both proving capability and inference cost. Applying an expensive solver to every subgoal wastes computation when cheaper models are sufficient, while always starting from the cheapest solver wastes attempts on subgoals that require stronger models. We present BudgetPV, an agentic budget-aware predict-and-verify system that allocates computation across unresolved subgoals and heterogeneous LLM solvers. BudgetPV uses a cross-solver predictor to guide solver selection for each subgoal and revises the allocation as verification feedback becomes available. The allocation problem changes as proving progresses. Early decisions mainly determine which solver should handle an untried subgoal, while later decisions determine which previously attempted subgoals should receive additional computation. We train the predictor with two objectives for these two stages. Class-weighted cross-entropy improves assignment to less frequent stronger solvers during the initial stage, while plain cross-entropy provides better calibrated probabilities for later allocation among previously attempted subgoals. We evaluate BudgetPV on Lean Workbook, miniF2F, ProofNet, and PutnamBench using three progressively expanded solver settings: a strong but expensive solver alone, adding a medium-cost solver with intermediate solving capability, and further adding a cheap solver with lower solving capability. be4ef5da7824c9fda5409bcc.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26910v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents are expected to improve themselves from their own experience across episodes, with fixed weights. Self-improvement in an embodied world cannot be read from one measure. Existing benchmarks measure task progress, world-knowledge question answering (QA), and episodic memory, but a correct answer does not show that the agent ever observed the evidence for it, and progress does not show what the agent learned. We introduce AstronautBench, which measures one agent's self-improvement through three views on the same run: what it knows, whether its own evidence supports that knowledge, and how far it gets in the world. It is built on the game Outer Wilds, where each episode is a 22-minute loop after which the world resets, only the agent's knowledge carries over, and progress is gated by knowledge. After every episode, we measure the places reached and ship-log rumor facts revealed, the correctness of answers to 164 questions about the world, and whether each answer is supported by the frames and position the agent cites from its own recorded play. Two LLM judges from different model families check every answer. In eight-episode baselines with GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Argon planners, which act through a learned controller or their own gamepad inputs, the three views do not move together, so any one of them alone gives an incomplete picture of whether the agent is improving. 6268402b584a08119054071a.title_original: Self-Evolving Beyond Human-Crafted Experience for EDA Scripting
6268402b584a08119054071a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The growing complexity of electronic systems demands efficient design flows, yet EDA scripting remains a bottleneck: proprietary APIs are sparsely documented, and errors often appear as silent failures or cryptic exceptions. Hand-crafted knowledge helps but is difficult to maintain as toolchains evolve. We present ZhuLong-SE (Self-Evolution), an execution-grounded LLM agent that learns reusable knowledge from prior task traces. Building on ZhuLong, it enhances the task-level harness with API retrieval, documentation responses, isolated sandbox execution, and static checking, then adds governed cross-task self-evolution. Beyond solving individual tasks, ZhuLong-SE distills past execution traces into a three-tier memory store governed by ground-truth anchoring, disconfirmation filtering, held-out rollback, and anti-leakage retrieval. On the 158-task EDA-Eval-PyAether benchmark, the full task-level harness, with self-evolution disabled, achieves 92.4% pass@1 and outperforms ZhuLong on all five tested LLM backbones. On a harder instance-disjoint test set, self-evolution from the bare configuration surpasses a human-crafted-experience baseline by 2.5 percentage points (80.0% vs. 77.5% pass@1).

53b7206bd5c804c10e281614.title_original: Self-similar Organization of Information in Language
53b7206bd5c804c10e281614.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How much information relevant to predicting the future of a passage (i.e. predictive information) is carried by the preceding text, and how is this information distributed along that history? These questions are fundamental to understanding both the statistical structure of language and what large language models (LLMs) can learn about it. Indeed, LLMs trained to predict the next token in text must exploit this predictive information, so its organization determines how the structure of language becomes available to the model to learn. We develop a theory for the organization of predictive information based on the scaling behavior of a family of information measures, and the theory predicts that if this organization has the same form at all measured length scales -- i.e., it has a self-similar structure -- then the information measures evaluated at different lengths collapse onto a common form. We observe this scaling collapse in long text documents, showing that predictive information is present at every length scale we measure and has a self-similar structure. Self-similarity is a considerably stronger property than showing the existence of long-range dependencies, and it constrains the process generating the text. More broadly, our results give quantitative support to the empirical observation that conditioning on more distant text continues to reveal new structure in language to LLMs.

055c62ccd1a72b073341dcef.title_original: CodeReviewBench: An Automated Benchmark for Evaluating the Software Factory
055c62ccd1a72b073341dcef.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As AI agents ship more code with minimal human oversight, code review becomes the critical quality-control checkpoint -- but one without a reliable, objective verifier: review quality is nuanced and ultimately a judgment call by the PR author. Existing benchmarks are structurally misaligned with this: annotators are third-party reviewers, like the bots they evaluate, not the PR authors who actually decide what to fix. They also rely on small, static issue sets that require full re-evaluation as tools update, limiting how frequently progress can be tracked. We introduce CodeReviewBench, built on a fundamentally different signal: revealed developer preferences -- if a developer acts on a bot's suggestion, we treat it as useful; if they ignore it, we do not. This signal is mined daily from the public GitHub event stream, yielding 500K+ judged PRs across 18 tools, and refreshes continuously as tools evolve. We validate the developer preference against an independent offline benchmark: the two agree on precision rankings and independently detect the same product updates within days of vendor releases. Together, these form the benchmark.

60732f1ace72e6440278be55.title_original: Keep the Process, Change the Supplier: Runtime Governance for Tool-Using AI Agents
60732f1ace72e6440278be55.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-using AI agents propose actions whose authorization and external effects cannot be inferred from generated text alone. We study an execution boundary that separates agent proposals from business-controlled authority, context disclosure, and supplier selection. The Open Process Control Plane (OPCP) mediates capability calls and records uncertain outcomes when a supplier may have acted without returning an acceptable reply. We evaluate this runtime with scripted requests and synthetic suppliers: 2,400 fault episodes across four policies, 60 process-termination/restart episodes, 19,000 timed calls across 19 configurations, five targeted mutations over 43 fixtures, and 160 substitution records. No language model or autonomous agent is evaluated. OPCP and a conservative composition agree on all measured fault outcomes. Both recover after definite refusal without cross-supplier duplication; retry-all duplicates effects in every tested lost-reply-after-commit case. Persistent runtime state prevents cross-supplier replay in the restart experiments, while same-supplier duplicate prevention also requires supplier idempotency. At 128 suppliers, best-score routing has a median latency of 1.411 ms versus 0.261 ms for pinned routing. All five selected mutations are detected, and record enumeration exposes acceptance of an empty regression set. These results characterize an execution mechanism relevant to agent governance, including its c

8228e11cbba9a8080149ea89.title_original: Right Numbers, Wrong Story: When LLMs Narrate Financial Changes Beyond Their Inputs
8228e11cbba9a8080149ea89.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A financial report drafted by an LLM can state every number correctly but still go beyond its input, adding judgments and causes that no one supplied. We call these additions unsupported framing and find them far more often in LLM drafts than in reports written by proInput facts Revenue +3% Higher prices 10-K filings Revenue increased 3% on higher prices. 10-K writer Revenue surged 3% on higher prices, due to strong demand. LLM Fits the size? Surged: Unusual for 3% In the input? In the input? Strong demand: Not in input Higher prices: Kept fessionals, and attempts to fix them by prompting with how each word is used instead make such judgments more frequent. We therefore propose FrameCheck, a plug-in that sits beFrameCheck Revenue increased 3% on higher prices. No extra model call Judgment word Unsupported cause Supported cause tween the LLM and human review to keep each draft within its input. Specifically, FrameCheck 1) guides the draft with professional examples that report a change of similar magnitude, 2) flags judgments that professionals would not use and causes the input does not give, and 3) removes them by rule, without a model call. In experiments on 17 open LLMs and 3M drafts, FrameCheck removes almost all unsupported framing from drafts and brings the judgment rate close to that of the writers of 10-K filings, the annual reports that US firms file with regulators. Code is available at github.com/seunghan96/framecheck

aa7af97c8dbd7272b0aa07dc.title_original: Run One, Get Two: Near-Free Streaming Safety Checks for Local LLMs
aa7af97c8dbd7272b0aa07dc.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local LLM assistants decode for one user at a time, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and leaves compute idle. Streaming safety checks today trade accuracy against cost. A dedicated guard model is accurate but nearly doubles the latency per token, while a hidden-state probe is cheap but less accurate. We present ToRA, an adapter that runs a second model as an extra row in the generator's decode step, sharing its weights and KV cache. Dual-row kernels read each weight once for both rows. On Qwen3-0.6B, ToRA matches or beats a dedicated streaming guard, with higher F1 on 12 of 17 benchmarks. It detects 11.8 points more unsafe responses than the probe at a similar cost, under 4% added latency per token.

28751d9d61f0dac70f342b3a.title_original: MixFold: Sub-4-Bit Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Output-Channel Grouping on Mobile NPUs
28751d9d61f0dac70f342b3a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sub-4-bit quantization allows mobile devices to run larger LLMs, but its memory savings do not always translate into faster decoding on mobile NPUs. Their matrix units support only a few native integer datatypes, and converting unsupported weight formats on the vector unit can erase the gains from fewer bits. Mixed precision faces an additional constraint: each matrix-unit tile uses one datatype. MixFold executes 3-bit and perfectly symmetric 2-bit weights using native integer operations without expanding the weights to wider datatypes during decoding. MixFold then assigns datatypes to output-channel groups aligned with the matrix-unit tiles, enabling finer-than-layer assignment without disrupting matrix-unit execution. We compare MixFold with llama.cpp Hexagon backend on the Qualcomm Hexagon NPU of a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5. Across the Qwen3 model family, MixFold achieves comparable or higher accuracy than llama.cpp's sub-4-bit formats at matched bits per weight, while decoding 1.16-1.41 times faster and generating 1.5-4.3 times more tokens per joule.
